news.title: Melvine Malard talks 'the good life' at Chelsea in matchday programme
news.title_zh: 梅尔文·马拉德在比赛日节目中谈论切尔西的“美好生活”
news.body_en: There’s plenty for everyone in the matchday programme for Sunday’s blockbuster Women's Super League fixture between Chelsea Women and Arsenal at Stamford Bridge. We’ve got an interview with Melvine Malard, who has hit the ground running in Blue, as well as Hannah Hampton’s ‘Firsts & Favs’, a pull-out poster of Veerle Buurman and columns from Sonia Bompastor, Erin Cuthbert and Barbara Charone. In a programme exclusive, Malard says she can now think about 'the good life' as she reflects on a summer in which she made the move from Manchester to London, received a Ballon d’Or nomination and got married as well. She’s also looking forward after getting her first taste of life in a Blues shirt. 'In this team, we have a lot of players that can make so much difference with their quality, speed, vision, and dribbling,' she says. 'For the No9 like me, that’s an amazing thing when you play in this team.' She also discusses head coach Bompastor, with whom she goes way back, and admits she can’t wait to get out there for this massive derby game. 'I think it means a lot in London, it’s a big day in English football – two big teams, with big players, a lot of fans, in a big stadium. I can’t wait because when you play football, you want games like this coming, and I hope when this game comes, we will win!' In addition to all of that, we’ve also got your in-depth head-to-head game preview, all the opposition info and the latest facts and stats, not to mention plenty of puzzles and games to keep everyone occupied before the big kick-off and on the journey home. So be sure to get your copy from the programme sellers around the stadium!
news.body_zh: 周日切尔西女足与阿森纳在斯坦福桥举行的重磅女足超级联赛比赛的比赛日节目中，每个人都有很多精彩内容。我们采访了梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard)，他在《蓝色》中崭露头角，还有汉娜·汉普顿 (Hannah Hampton) 的《Firsts & Favs》、维尔勒·布尔曼 (Veerle Buurman) 的海报以及索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor)、艾琳·库斯伯特 (Erin Cuthbert) 和芭芭拉·查隆 (Barbara Charone) 的专栏。在一档独家节目中，马拉德表示，她现在可以思考“美好的生活”，因为她回顾了一个夏天，她从曼彻斯特搬到了伦敦，获得了金球奖提名，还结婚了。在第一次体验蓝调衬衫的生活后，她也很期待。 “在这支球队中，我们有很多球员，他们的能力、速度、视野和盘带能力都可以发挥很大作用，”她说。 “对于像我这样的九号位来说，当你在这支球队踢球时，这是一件了不起的事情。”她还谈到了她很久以前就和他在一起的主教练邦帕斯托，并承认她迫不及待地想参加这场大型德比比赛。 “我认为这对伦敦来说意义重大，这是英国足球的重要一天——两支大球队，拥有伟大的球员，很多球迷，在一个大体育场里。我等不及了，因为当你踢足球时，你希望这样的比赛到来，我希望当这场比赛到来时，我们会赢！”除此之外，我们还为您提供了深入的面对面比赛预览、所有对手信息以及最新的事实和统计数据，更不用说大量的谜题和游戏，让每个人在大型开赛前和回家的路上都忙碌起来。因此，请务必从体育场周围的节目销售商那里购买副本！

news.title: Millie Bright's incredible Chelsea tenure celebrated in behind-the-scenes exclusive documentary
news.title_zh: 幕后独家纪录片庆祝米莉·布莱特令人难以置信的切尔西任期
news.body_en: Millie, an exclusive documentary celebrating the storied career of our former captain Millie Bright, is coming soon! Bright retired from football in April after 12 unforgettable years at Chelsea. With 314 appearances and a place in the side for all 20 major trophies won in our history, her legacy will continue far beyond her playing days. She is the first women's team player to be immortalised on the Shed Wall, while the sensory room at Stamford Bridge is now named in her honour to mark the work she has done off the pitch, which she will continue after being named a Chelsea Foundation trustee. The documentary goes behind the scenes at her family home in Killamarsh, talking to her grassroots coaches and the Bright family about how she began her football journey as a child. It will be available to watch in full tomorrow morning, but you can get a peek at what is to come in the preview below. Bright recounts some of the most personal moments of her incredible Chelsea career, discusses her winning mentality and talks with honesty about the reasons behind her decision to retire from football. The former Blues captain's career trajectory ran parallel to the growth of women's football, and she saw firsthand how the popularity of the Women's Super League exploded after she was part of England's Women's European Championship-winning side in 2022. 'I went in as one person, came out as something completely different,' she told us when she announced her retirement. 'It was the most overwhelming situation I've ever been in. I just didn't know what to do with myself. I didn't leave the house for six days!' There's also a look inside her passion for helping others and inspiring the next generation of footballers, as one of the most experienced voices in the women's game. This is a chance for Blues fans to get to know the person who lies underneath all the trophies and the success, and what drove her to reach those heights. The full in-depth documentary will be available to watch exclusively on the Chelsea Official App and website from 10am on Sunday - just make sure you are signed in!
news.body_zh: 一部庆祝我们前队长米莉·布莱特传奇职业生涯的独家纪录片《米莉》即将推出！在切尔西度过了难忘的 12 年之后，布莱特于 4 月退役。她出场 314 次，并在球队历史上赢得了全部 20 座重要奖杯，她的传奇将在她职业生涯结束后继续延续。她是第一位在棚墙上永垂不朽的女队球员，而斯坦福桥的感官室现在以她的名字命名，以纪念她在球场外所做的工作，在被任命为切尔西基金会受托人后，她将继续下去。这部纪录片在她位于基拉马什的家中进行幕后采访，与她的基层教练和布莱特一家谈论她小时候如何开始自己的足球之旅。明天早上即可完整观看，但您可以在下面的预览中了解即将发生的内容。布莱特讲述了她令人难以置信的切尔西职业生涯中一些最个人化的时刻，讨论了她的获胜心态，并诚实地谈论了她决定退役的原因。这位前蓝军队长的职业生涯轨迹与女足的发展并行，她在2022年成为英格兰女足欧洲杯冠军球队的一员后，亲眼目睹了女足超级联赛的受欢迎程度如何爆发式增长。“我进去时是一个人，出来时却是完全不同的人，”她在宣布退役时告诉我们。 “这是我经历过的最难以承受的情况。我只是不知道该怎么办。我已经六天没有离开家了！”作为女子足球界最有经验的声音之一，她还热衷于帮助他人和激励下一代足球运动员。对于蓝军球迷来说，这是一个了解所有奖杯和成功背后的人的机会，以及是什么驱使她达到这些高度。完整的深度纪录片将于周日上午 10 点起在切尔西官方应用程序和网站上独家观看 - 只需确保您已登录即可！

news.title: Jordan Henderson: My Football Firsts
news.title_zh: 乔丹·亨德森：我的足球第一
news.body_en: Jordan Henderson takes on our quick-fire questions about his early days in football to help you get to know our summer signing a little better. What was the first football match you went to? My first game would have been at Roker Park, to see Sunderland. I can't remember the exact game, but that’s where it would have been, when I was very young. What were your first pair of football boots? I can’t remember what type, but they were probably Nike. What was the first football kit you owned? Probably the Sunderland kit, I definitely would have had a Sunderland shirt when I was very young. I think I can remember having a reversible Barcelona one as well, that was gold on one side. What was the first team you played for? You’re testing my memory! I’m older than everyone else, it was longer ago for me. I can’t remember, sorry. Who was your first room-mate on away trips? I played in the youth team with Martyn Waghorn. That was the youngest, I think, we were youth team age. Who was your first professional game against? In the Premier League it was against Chelsea at Stamford Bridge. I can remember it well because we lost 5-0! We were 3-0 down at half-time, and I came on, so it was not great. But it was a good Chelsea team we were playing against. I think my first-ever match for Sunderland was in a pre-season game against Ajax. Who was your first professional goal against? Professionally, I think it was for Coventry when I was on loan, against Norwich away in the Championship. What was your first emotion when you signed for Chelsea? It was a huge opportunity I couldn’t turn down. I was very excited to get going.
news.body_zh: 乔丹·亨德森回答了我们关于他早期足球生涯的快速问题，以帮助您更好地了解我们的夏季签约。你去看的第一场足球比赛是哪场？我的第一场比赛是在罗克公园球场，对阵桑德兰。我不记得具体的比赛了，但那是我很小的时候的比赛。您的第一双足球鞋是什么？我不记得是什么类型，但可能是耐克。您拥有的第一套足球装备是什么？可能是桑德兰的球衣，当我很小的时候，我肯定会拥有一件桑德兰的球衣。我想我还记得有一件双面巴塞罗那版，一侧是金色的。你效力的第一支球队是哪支球队？你这是在考验我的记忆力！我比其他人都老，对我来说那是很久以前的事情了。我不记得了，抱歉。谁是你外出旅行时的第一个室友？我和马丁·瓦霍恩一起在青年队踢球。我认为那是最年轻的，我们正值青年队年龄。你的第一场职业比赛是对阵谁？在英超联赛中，比赛是在斯坦福桥对阵切尔西。我记得很清楚，因为我们0-5输了！半场结束时我们0-3落后，我上场了，所以情况不太好。但我们面对的是一支优秀的切尔西队。我认为我代表桑德兰的第一场比赛是对阵阿贾克斯的季前赛。你的第一个职业进球是对阵谁？从职业角度来说，我认为我租借期间是在考文垂，在英冠联赛中客场对阵诺维奇。当你加盟切尔西时，你的第一感觉是什么？这是一个我无法拒绝的巨大机会。我很高兴能够出发。

news.title: From the archive: Peter Bonetti on the 1970 FA Cup final
news.title_zh: 档案摘录：Peter Bonetti 谈 1970 年足总杯决赛
news.body_en: On what would have been his 85th birthday, we look back to when the late, great Peter Bonetti shared his account of one of his greatest moments at Chelsea, our maiden FA Cup triumph in 1970. In the eyes of many, Bonetti - who sadly passed away in 2020 - is regarded as Chelsea's most legendary goalkeeper, and one of the greatest of his incredible 729 games for the Blues was reserved for the biggest of stages. In the FA Cup final of 1969/70, ‘the Cat’ was bright, brave and brilliant across two hours of high-octane, high-stakes football. He made some truly spectacular saves in the first game at Wembley and was our stand-out player as Dave Sexton’s side twice came from behind to force a replay. Up at Old Trafford a fortnight later, with a record TV audience of over 28 million watching at home, Bonetti’s efforts were superhuman as he battled through an early injury to defy Leeds United as our last line of defence. Although it was feline agility and reflexes that earned him his nickname, it was the heart of a lion in Manchester that saw him soldier on through another period of extra time, during which David Webb bundled in that famous winner to ensure the Blues were FA Cup victors for the very first time in our history. Those who watched at the time recall it as one of the most memorable goalkeeping performances in FA Cup final history, while the man who wore the gloves remembers it as the most physical game of his career. ‘They’re two of the most important games, as far as I’m concerned, in Chelsea’s history,’ Bonetti told us in 2010. ‘My memories of the FA Cup final are fantastic and obviously the games were quite exceptional too. ‘It was between two teams that didn’t really like one another and so it was obviously going to be a very physical battle between the two. I’d say that the replay at Old Trafford was the most physical game I ever played in. ‘I wasn’t necessarily referring to the Mick Jones incident where he banged into my knee because that sort of thing can happen – you go up and try to catch a ball and someone challenges you. His knee caught my knee and I don’t think it was deliberate. ‘So I didn’t just mean it was physical because of that, but both teams were so desperate to win because they didn’t like one another at the time. And I must say "at the time" because it’s a bit different today! ‘If the game had been refereed according to the rules and regulations of today, it wouldn’t have lasted! The tackling was wild, you had people kicking each other six foot in the air and trying to kick the ball as someone headed it! ‘But that was the way the game was played in those days, it was very physical. You were out to win, just like nowadays, but it was played in a more aggressive manner, I must admit.’ Bonetti felt it was the Chelsea character that proved the difference between two well-matched teams and speculated on what might have been had his own Herculean effort proved insufficient to keep him on the field after that first-half knee injury. A collision with Leeds centre-forward Jones had done the damage, leaving the Chelsea No1 struggling to even walk properly and requiring a pain-killing injection at half-time. At a time before substitute goalkeepers had been introduced to the game, there was a chance that the eventual match-winner could have had an altogether different role to play. ‘We showed great character over the two games,’ continued Bonetti. ‘I think we were behind three times and got back each time before Webby got the winner. It showed we had great character as a team and a tremendous blend of players. ‘We weren’t surprised when Webby got the goal. He was a great character who was fearless – he’d go up for set-pieces and just throw himself at everything. And he was a very recognised goal scorer too. He scored in the quarter-final and semi-final that year, and I remember him scoring three goals in a Boxing Day match at Ipswich once. He had the eye for a goal, no doubt about it. ‘If my knee injury had kept me out of the game then he’d have been the one to go in goal! If I got injured, he used to go in goal.’ The Cat was voted runner-up in the Footballer of the Year award at the end of that campaign, his FA Cup winners’ medal alongside others in the League Cup, European Cup Winners’ Cup and, of course, the FIFA World Cup. After hanging up his gloves in 1986, it was those medals that ultimately provided most pride to Bonetti. ‘It was the first time the club had ever won the FA Cup and the other thing was that it meant we won medals,' he concluded. ‘You always look back on your career at times when you have won something and there’s so many players who go through their careers without winning anything. So I regard myself as being lucky at having been able to win a couple of things.’ For the supporters who watched him at Stamford Bridge in his prime, it was certainly the Blues who were the lucky ones, for being able to count on Bonetti between the posts during an unbelievable Chelsea career spanning 20 years.
news.body_zh: 在他 85 岁生日之际，我们回顾了已故伟大的彼得·博内蒂分享的他在切尔西最伟大时刻之一的经历，即 1970 年我们首次夺得足总杯冠军。在很多人眼中，于 2020 年不幸去世的博内蒂被认为是切尔西最传奇的门将，他为蓝军效力的 729 场比赛中最伟大的一场被保留在最盛大的舞台上。在 1969/70 赛季的足总杯决赛中，“猫”在两个小时的高强度、高风险的足球比赛中表现得聪明、勇敢和出色。他在温布利的第一场比赛中做出了一些真正精彩的扑救，在戴夫·塞克斯顿的球队两次落后迫使重赛时，他是我们表现出色的球员。两周后，在老特拉福德，主场电视观众人数超过 2800 万，创历史新高。博内蒂在早期受伤的情况下奋力抗争，挑战了作为我们最后一道防线的利兹联队，他的努力是超人的。尽管猫科动物般的敏捷性和反应能力为他赢得了这个绰号，但正是曼彻斯特雄狮的心让他在又一个加时赛中奋勇前行，在此期间大卫·韦伯打进了那个著名的制胜球，确保了蓝军历史上第一次成为足总杯冠军。当时观看比赛的人回忆起这是足总杯决赛历史上最令人难忘的守门员表演之一，而戴上手套的人则认为这是他职业生涯中最激烈的比赛。 “就我而言，这是切尔西历史上最重要的两场比赛，”博内蒂在 2010 年告诉我们。“我对足总杯决赛的记忆非常美妙，显然那些比赛也非常特别。” “这是两支并不真正喜欢对方的球队之间的比赛，因此显然这将是两支球队之间的一场非常激烈的身体对抗。我想说，老特拉福德的重赛是我参加过的最激烈的比赛。“我不一定指的是米克·琼斯撞到我膝盖的事件，因为这种事情可能会发生——你站起来试图接球，有人挑战你。”他的膝盖撞到了我的膝盖，我不认为这是故意的。 “所以我的意思不仅仅是因为身体原因，而是两支球队都非常渴望获胜，因为他们当时不喜欢对方。我必须说“当时”，因为今天有点不同！ ‘如果比赛按照今天的规则进行裁判的话，比赛就不会持续下去了！抢断非常疯狂，人们在空中互相踢六英尺，并试图在有人头球时踢球！ “但这就是当时比赛的方式，非常需要身体对抗。你本来就是为了赢球，就像现在一样，但我必须承认，比赛的方式更具侵略性。”博内蒂认为，切尔西的性格证明了两支势均力敌的球队之间的差异，并推测，在上半场膝盖受伤后，如果他自己的巨大努力不足以让他留在场上，他可能会做出什么贡献。与利兹联中锋琼斯的碰撞造成了伤害，导致这位切尔西一号球员甚至难以正常行走，需要在半场休息时注射止痛药。在替补守门员被引入比赛之前，最终的获胜者有可能扮演完全不同的角色。 “我们在这两场比赛中表现出了出色的性格，”博内蒂继续说道。 “我认为我们曾三次落后，但每次都在韦比获胜之前扳回一城。这表明我们作为一个团队拥有伟大的性格和优秀的球员组合。 “当韦比进球时，我们并不感到惊讶。他是一个无所畏惧的伟大人物——他会拼尽全力去争取定位球。他也是一位非常受认可的射手。那年他在四分之一决赛和半决赛中都有进球，我记得有一次他在节礼日对阵伊普斯维奇的比赛中攻入三球。毫无疑问，他有目标的眼光。 “如果我的膝盖受伤让我缺席比赛，那么他就是那个进球的人！如果我受伤了，他就会进球。”在那场比赛结束时，猫被评为年度最佳足球先生亚军，他在联赛杯、欧洲优胜者杯，当然还有国际足联世界杯上与其他人一起获得了足总杯冠军奖牌。 1986 年挂起手套后，这些奖牌最终给博内蒂带来了最大的自豪。 “这是俱乐部第一次赢得足总杯冠军，另一件事是，这意味着我们赢得了奖牌，”他总结道。 “当你赢得一些东西时，你总是会回顾自己的职业生涯，而有很多球员在职业生涯中却什么也没赢得。因此，我认为自己很幸运，能够赢得一些东西。”对于那些在斯坦福桥观看他巅峰时期的球迷来说，蓝军无疑是幸运的，因为能够在长达 20 年的令人难以置信的切尔西职业生涯中依靠博内蒂在各个门柱之间发挥作用。

news.title: Internationals: Goal and assist for Acheampong as Lavia makes winning return
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：拉维亚回归，阿奇姆蓬进球并助攻
news.body_en: Josh Acheampong scored his first goal for England at Under-21 level while Romeo Lavia and Maxence Lacroix opened their UEFA Nations League campaigns with victories. Lavia’s solitary previous international cap had come in March 2023, but his impressive start to the season with Chelsea saw him named in new Belgium manager Mark van Bommel’s first squad. His return to the pitch for his country came off the bench for the final 15 minutes, as he helped Belgium see out a professional but deserved 2-0 win away against Italy, to make a victorious start to the new Nations League campaign. Mark Penders was not involved for Belgium, while Honest Ahanor – who will join Chelsea next year – was an unused substitute for Italy. Lacroix featured at centre-back for the full 90 minutes as Zinedine Zidane made a winning start to life as France manager, beating Turkiye 1-0 in their own Nations League opener. They were made to work hard for their victory though, with chances for both teams before and after Kylian Mbappe’s solitary goal, until a late red card for Turkiye helped Les Blues and Lacroix to hold on to their clean sheet and the three points. Belgium and France will next face each other in the Nations League, in Brussels on Monday evening. Acheampong was named in England Under-21s’ starting line-up alongside fellow Blue Jamie Gittens, as they took on Kazakhstan in qualifying for next year’s UEFA European Under-21 Championship. In an end-to-end match the defender found the bottom corner with a sweet strike to put the Young Lions 2-1 up, having originally fallen behind, but the scores were levelled by half-time. Acheampong played a big part in England retaking the lead after the break, as his cushioned header was volleyed in by his centre-back partner Max Alleyne, before they scored again in added time to secure a 4-2 win. Another victory over Slovakia next Friday would officially book reigning champions England’s place at Euro 2027 with a game to spare. Geovany Quenda was in the Portugal Under-21s side which suffered a narrow defeat away at Bulgaria. He forced an excellent save from the home goalkeeper on three occasions before Portugal took the lead, but was withdrawn in the 88th minute, shortly after Bulgaria had equalised. That meant he was powerless to prevent his team conceding a decisive injury-time goal to lose 2-1. Defeat denied them qualification for the Under-21 Euros on the night, although a home win over Gibraltar on Wednesday would seal Portugal’s spot, regardless of other results. Elsewhere, Freddy Bernal and Chizaram Ezenwata both started for England Under-19s - as did Reggie Walsh, who is spending this season on loan with Wigan Athletic - in their narrow 1-0 friendly win over the Republic of Ireland at St George's Park.
news.body_zh: 乔什·阿奇姆蓬 (Josh Acheampong) 攻入了他在 21 岁以下国家队的首个进球，而罗密欧·拉维亚 (Romeo Lavia) 和马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦 (Maxence Lacroix) 则以胜利开启了他们的欧洲国家联赛之旅。拉维亚上一次代表国家队出场是在 2023 年 3 月，但他在切尔西的赛季开局令人印象深刻，因此入选了新任比利时主帅马克·范博梅尔的一线队。他在最后15分钟替补重返球场，帮助比利时客场2-0战胜意大利，取得了一场胜利，为新一届国家联赛开局。马克·彭德斯没有参加比利时队的比赛，而将于明年加盟切尔西的诚实·阿哈诺则在意大利队中没有上场。拉克鲁瓦在整场 90 分钟的比赛中担任中卫，齐达内在法国队的国联揭幕战中以 1-0 击败土耳其队，为法国队取得了胜利的开局。不过，他们必须为胜利而努力，在基利安·姆巴佩的唯一进球之前和之后，两支球队都有机会，直到图尔基耶最后一张红牌帮助蓝军和拉克鲁瓦保住了不失球和三分。比利时和法国接下来将于周一晚上在布鲁塞尔举行的国家联赛中交锋。 Acheampong 与蓝军队友杰米·吉滕斯一起入选英格兰 21 岁以下青年队的首发阵容，他们将与哈萨克斯坦队争夺明年欧洲 21 岁以下青年锦标赛的资格。在一场对决中，后卫攻入底角，一记漂亮的射门帮助原本落后的幼狮队2-1领先，但半场结束时比分被扳平。阿奇姆蓬在英格兰队中场休息后重新取得领先的过程中发挥了重要作用，他的头球被他的中后卫搭档马克斯·阿莱恩(Max Alleyne)凌空抽射，随后英格兰队在补时阶段再次进球，最终以4-2获胜。下周五如果再战胜斯洛伐克，卫冕冠军英格兰队将正式获得 2027 年欧洲杯的参赛资格，而且还剩一场比赛。乔瓦尼·昆达所在的葡萄牙21岁以下青年队在客场险胜保加利亚。在葡萄牙取得领先之前，他曾三次精彩扑救主队门将，但在保加利亚扳平比分后不久的第88分钟就被撤回。这意味着他无力阻止球队在伤停补时阶段丢掉决定性的进球，最终以 2-1 告负。尽管周三主场战胜直布罗陀，无论其他结果如何，葡萄牙队将锁定席位，但失败使他们失去了当晚参加 21 岁以下欧洲杯的资格。在其他地方，弗雷迪·伯纳尔和奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔都为英格兰 19 岁以下青年队首发——本赛季租借到维冈竞技的雷吉·沃尔什也是如此——在圣乔治公园以 1-0 险胜爱尔兰共和国的友谊赛中。

news.title: Key talking points from Sonia Bompastor's pre-Arsenal press conference
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托在阿森纳赛前新闻发布会上的主要谈话要点
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor faced the media at Cobham ahead of our Women's Super League clash with Arsenal at Stamford Bridge, and here are the stand-out talking points from her press conference. We host the Gunners at Stamford Bridge on Sunday afternoon, and if you haven't got your ticket sorted already, you can still purchase yours here. The Blues have won all but one of our six matches so far this season, the anomaly a 1-1 draw with Aston Villa on the opening day of the Women's Super League campaign. Chelsea supporters are being asked to wear blue to make this London derby a 'Blue Day' in the stands and the whole team is looking forward to the clash, as Bompastor explained... 'It's two great teams going against each other. So when you are passionate about football, as a head coach and a player, you want to be involved in those games. 'We are really excited for the game on Sunday. We are playing at home, at Stamford Bridge. We are hoping for our fans to come and support us and hopefully we'll put on a strong performance to have a great afternoon.' 'I think it's important to have players who are able to beat their opponent, especially when you play against a team who are man-marking. 'Alyssa has the technicality and the speed to always beat her opponent one-v-one no matter the situation, whether she's facing forward or whether she's receiving the ball to feet and going beyond the back line. She's a player who loves to play with freedom because she has a lot of instinct and it's great to have a player like her. 'She can make a lot of difference on the pitch, so that's really important as well, especially when you play in big games.' 'I think fine margins will decide the game for sure and the details are really important. Both teams will have to be really strong in the defensive aspects not to concede, but also to create and be clinical to score the opportunities we make in the game. 'It's a massive fixture not only for the club and the players, but also for the fans. We want to play from the first minute until the end of the game and we will give our all to make sure we bring the fans along with us. The best way is to score and to embrace the game. So we'll try to do that.' 'I think that was the first time in the season where we faced a team with a direct style of football. The only thing they wanted to do is to play long balls behind the back line, then fight for the first and the second ball. 'So it was good for us to be in that position. And even against a team who played direct, I don't think we conceded many opportunities. I think we were strong in the duels and also we dealt well with the transitions. 'But also we faced a team who were man-marking everywhere on the pitch. We spoke a lot about finding solutions when you play a team who are doing that in terms of the spaces and the different movements you need to create the space. 'It was really positive to be going into these next two games having faced a team who were causing us some challenges. So it's good to approach Sunday's game having had this one in the bag.' 'I think for me, the most important thing – as I told my players – it's not always about the system, but instead it's about the way we animate the system. 'But we don't change our main principles and our philosophy no matter what system we are playing. So for me, I have players smart enough to know and to recognise the positions they need to play and what they need to do in every position they are playing in, and they are adaptable with that, so it's good.' Don't miss our huge London derby clash against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge! Secure your seat now...
news.body_zh: 在斯坦福桥与阿森纳的女足超级联赛比赛之前，索尼娅·邦帕斯托在科巴姆接受了媒体采访，以下是她在新闻发布会上的重要谈话要点。周日下午我们将在斯坦福桥迎战枪手队，如果您还没有找到门票，您仍然可以在这里购买门票。本赛季到目前为止，蓝军在六场比赛中只赢了一场，其中异常的是在女足超级联赛揭幕战中1-1战平阿斯顿维拉。切尔西的支持者被要求穿蓝色衣服，让这场伦敦德比成为看台上的“蓝色日”，全队都期待着这场冲突，正如邦帕斯特解释的那样……“这是两支伟大的球队相互对抗。”因此，当你对足球充满热情时，作为主教练和球员，你会想参与到这些比赛中。 “我们对周日的比赛感到非常兴奋。我们在斯坦福桥的主场比赛。我们希望球迷能够前来支持我们，希望我们能拿出出色的表现，度过一个美好的下午。” “我认为拥有能够击败对手的球员很重要，尤其是当你对阵一支盯人的球队时。 “阿莉莎拥有技术性和速度，无论在什么情况下，无论她是面朝前方，还是脚接球并越过后线，她总是能在一对一的情况下击败对手。她是一位喜欢自由发挥的球员，因为她有很多本能，拥有像她这样的球员真是太好了。 “她可以在球场上发挥很大的作用，所以这也非常重要，尤其是当你参加大型比赛时。” “我认为良好的利润肯定会决定比赛的结果，细节非常重要。两支球队都必须在防守方面非常强大，才能不失球，同时还要创造并冷静地抓住我们在比赛中创造的机会。 “这不仅对俱乐部和球员来说是一场盛大的比赛，对球迷来说也是如此。我们希望从第一分钟一直打到比赛结束，我们将竭尽全力确保球迷与我们同在。最好的方法是得分并拥抱比赛。所以我们会尝试这样做。 “我认为这是本赛季我们第一次面对一支具有直接足球风格的球队。他们唯一想做的就是在后卫线后面打长传，然后争夺第一球和第二球。 “所以我们处于这个位置对我们来说是件好事。即使对阵直接打球的球队，我认为我们也没有丢掉很多机会。我认为我们在决斗中表现强劲，而且我们也很好地处理了过渡。 “但我们也面临着一支在球场上到处盯人的球队。我们谈论了很多关于当你与一支正在做空间和创造空间所需的不同动作方面这样做的团队时寻找解决方案的问题。 “在接下来的两场比赛中面对一支给我们带来一些挑战的球队真的很积极。因此，带着这个包进入周日的比赛是件好事。” “我认为对我来说，最重要的事情 - 正如我告诉我的球员 - 它并不总是与系统有关，而是与我们为系统提供动画的方式有关。 “但无论我们采用什么体系，我们都不会改变我们的主要原则和理念。所以对我来说，我的球员足够聪明，能够了解并认识到他们需要踢的位置以及他们在每个位置上需要做什么，并且他们能够适应这一点，所以这很好。不要错过我们在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的伦敦德比大战！赶紧抢座位吧……

news.title: Sonia Bompastor gives fitness updates on Lauren James and Keira Walsh
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 分享劳伦·詹姆斯 (Lauren James) 和凯拉·沃尔什 (Keira Walsh) 的最新健身情况
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor delivered a team news update on a key Chelsea quartet ahead of our London derby with Arsenal on Sunday afternoon. The Blues face a big test this weekend as we go up against rivals Arsenal, and Bompastor gave the latest on who she will have available to face the Gunners. There remains a doubt over whether two of our key players will be fit to start at Stamford Bridge on Sunday. Lauren James missed Wednesday evening's win over Austria Vienna with what the head coach described as a small knock, while Keira Walsh started in midweek but was substituted 20 minutes in, after feeling some pain in her calf. 'It's probably one of the first times I'm not in a position to share a lot with you,' explained Bompastor. 'Because we played two days ago, and we still have a training session tomorrow. 'I need to meet with my performance staff to assess all the players and I'll probably have more information tomorrow before the game.' There was some good news about another key duo from the Friday afternoon press conference. After a pre-planned substitution at half-time against Austria Vienna, Melvine Malard came through unscathed and will be available for selection on Sunday. Our head coach explained some of the striker's key attributes. 'Melvine was training this morning, so she's in a good place,' Bompastor continued. 'She's in contention for the game on Sunday. It was the plan for her to play 45 minutes. She's still building from pre-season. 'I think she's a player who is really confident now. She's the No9 for the French national team, but she also came into our environment with a lot of confidence from last season and the good season she had with Man United. 'She's really technical and has a lot of speed in the attacking line, so she's a threat for any team, and I think it's good to have her in our squad. So hopefully she'll have a good game on Sunday if she's starting or coming on.' Naomi Girma is also returning to fitness and was an unused substitute in Wednesday night's Women's Champions League win. Bompastor explained where the defender is up to in terms of her availability. 'Nay is training fully right now with the squad,' said the head coach. 'I think in the game on Wednesday, it was not always easy to bring defenders on, especially in the last 10 minutes where the balls were coming and they were playing direct football. 'But she's doing good. She's training fully. I think probably what we need to get from Nay is being consistently on the pitch, but we are all around her trying to support her to be able to achieve that. 'It's great to have a player with her mentality. She's a hard worker and she brings a lot of quality. So if she's able to get minutes again and stay consistently on the pitch, it will be great news.' news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特在周日下午与阿森纳的伦敦德比之前发布了有关切尔西四重奏的球队新闻更新。蓝军本周末将面临一场重大考验，我们将对阵对手阿森纳，邦帕斯特透露了她将与枪手对阵的最新消息。我们的两名关键球员是否能够在周日的斯坦福桥首发上场仍然存在疑问。劳伦·詹姆斯错过了周三晚上战胜奥地利维也纳的比赛，主教练称这是一次小碰撞，而凯拉·沃尔什在周中首发，但在感到小腿有些疼痛后在 20 分钟后被换下。 “这可能是我第一次无法与您分享很多内容，”邦帕斯特解释道。 “因为我们两天前就踢了比赛，明天我们还有训练。 “我需要与我的表现人员会面，评估所有球员，明天比赛前我可能会得到更多信息。”周五下午的新闻发布会上有关于另一位关键二人组的好消息。在对阵奥地利维也纳的比赛中场休息时按计划换人后，梅尔文·马拉德毫发无伤，并将在周日入选。我们的主教练解释了这位前锋的一些关键属性。 “梅尔文今天早上正在训练，所以她的状态很好，”邦帕斯特继续说道。 “她正在争夺周日的比赛。她原计划打45分钟。她仍在季前赛中继续训练。 “我认为她现在是一位非常自信的球员。她是法国国家队的9号球员，但她也带着上赛季和在曼联度过的美好赛季的自信来到了我们的环境。 “她的技术非常好，在进攻线上速度很快，所以她对任何球队都是一个威胁，我认为让她加入我们的阵容是件好事。因此，如果她首发或上场的话，希望她能在周日打出一场精彩的比赛。”娜奥米·吉尔玛也正在恢复健康，并在周三晚上的女子冠军联赛胜利中作为替补未上场。邦帕斯特解释了这名后卫的可用情况。 “内现在正在与球队一起进行全面训练，”主教练说。 “我认为在周三的比赛中，让防守队员上场并不总是那么容易，特别是在最后10分钟，球来了，他们踢的是直接足球。 '但她做得很好。她正在全力训练。我认为我们需要从娜伊那里得到的可能是在球场上始终如一，但我们都在她身边，努力支持她实现这一目标。 “拥有像她这样心态的球员真是太好了。她是一个勤奋的人，她带来了很多品质。因此，如果她能够再次获得上场时间并始终如一地留在场上，那将是个好消息。现在购买门票，观看即将在桥上举行的激动人心的伦敦德比，还为时不晚！单击此处以确保您的安全...

news.title: Internationals: Estevao denied goal on Brazil return
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：埃斯特沃在巴西回归时进球被拒
news.body_en: Estevao Willian made his return to Brazil’s starting line-up and was close to marking it by netting a decisive goal, but had to settle for a draw after his strike was ruled out. The Chelsea winger was recalled by the Selecao for this international window, which they begin with back-to-back friendlies away against Australia. Joao Pedro had also been named in their squad, but was later withdrawn. Estevao went straight into Carlo Ancelotti’s line-up for the first of those friendlies down under, making his first start for his country since scoring in a 1-1 draw with Tunisia last November. It was nearly a similar story in this match, when Estevao thought he had given his team the lead in first-half stoppage time by firing into the bottom-left corner. However, VAR intervened and disallowed the goal for a foul by Bruno Guimaraes in the build-up. Instead it was the hosts Australia who took the lead through a Nestory Irankunda free-kick after the break, despite Brazil having the better of the possession. Estevao was withdrawn with 15 minutes remaining, but Brazil managed to salvage a draw with virtually the last kick of the game, when Rayan headed in a Raphinha corner in the fifth minute of added time. After that 1-1 draw, Brazil and Australia will meet again in Sydney on Tuesday, with kick-off at 11am UK time.
news.body_zh: 埃斯特沃·威廉重返巴西首发阵容，差点打入决定性进球，但在他的进球被判无效后，只能以平局收场。这位切尔西边锋被桑巴军团召回参加本次国际比赛，他们从客场对阵澳大利亚的背靠背友谊赛开始。若昂·佩德罗也曾入选他们的阵容，但后来被撤回。埃斯特沃直接进入了安切洛蒂的首发阵容，参加了澳大利亚的第一场友谊赛，这是他自去年11月1-1战平突尼斯队进球后首次代表国家队首发。这场比赛的情况也几乎类似，埃斯特沃认为自己在上半场补时阶段射入左下角，帮助球队取得了领先。然而，VAR介入并判定布鲁诺·吉马良斯在进攻中犯规，进球无效。相反，东道主澳大利亚队在中场休息后通过内斯托里·伊兰昆达的任意球取得领先，尽管巴西队拥有更好的控球权。埃斯特瓦奥在比赛还剩 15 分钟时被撤下，但巴西队在补时第 5 分钟拉扬接到拉芬哈角球时头球破门，几乎是在比赛的最后一脚挽救了平局。 1-1 战平后，巴西队和澳大利亚队将于周二在悉尼再次相遇，比赛时间为英国时间上午 11 点。

news.body_en: Joao Pedro has been named on the shortlist for the September Premier League Creative Moment of the Month award for his brilliant piece of skill against Hull City. A strong start to the 2026/27 season has already seen our Brazilian striker named as the Premier League Player of the Month in August, and he has now been nominated for a second Premier League award in as many months. Vote for Joao Pedro to win Premier League Creative Moment of the Month It came from one particular passage of play in the draw with Hull, when the Blues were pushing for a winning goal after Joao Pedro had netted our equaliser, and he demonstrated why he has been such a handful for defences during the early stages of this season. First he fooled everyone with a clever dummy to allow Reece James’ pass to run through to Danny Welbeck, then seconds later found his fellow striker again, showing great vision and technique to redirect Cole Palmer’s ball with a back-heeled flick. Voting for the September Premier League Creative Moment of the Month is open now, and you can cast your vote for Joao Pedro to receive the award here until the poll closes at midday on Monday 28 September. The winner will be announced at 1pm on Thursday 1 October. The Blues forward is one of five nominated players on the award’s September shortlist, alongside Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal), Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa), Abdul Fatawu (Ipswich Town) and Liam Delap (Nottingham Forest).
news.body_zh: 若昂·佩德罗因其在对阵赫尔城的比赛中的出色表现而入围九月份英超联赛本月创意时刻奖的候选名单。 2026/27 赛季的强劲开局让我们的巴西前锋在 8 月份被评为英超本月最佳球员，现在他在几个月内第二次获得英超联赛奖项提名。投票支持若昂·佩德罗赢得本月英超创意时刻 这来自于与赫尔城的平局中的一个特殊段落，当时若昂·佩德罗扳平比分，蓝军正在努力争取制胜一球，他证明了为什么他在本赛季早期阶段的防守如此糟糕。首先，他用一个聪明的假人欺骗了所有人，让里斯·詹姆斯的传球传给了丹尼·维尔贝克，几秒钟后，他再次找到了他的前锋同伴，展示了出色的视野和技术，用后跟轻弹改变了科尔·帕尔默的球方向。 9月英超联赛本月创意时刻投票现已开放，您可以在此投票支持若昂·佩德罗获奖，直至 9 月 28 日星期一中午投票结束。获胜者将于 10 月 1 日星期四下午 1 点公布。这位蓝军前锋是该奖项九月份入围名单上的五名提名球员之一，其他球员包括马丁·祖比门迪（阿森纳）、埃米利亚诺·布恩迪亚（阿斯顿维拉）、阿卜杜勒·法塔乌（伊普斯维奇镇）和利亚姆·德拉普（诺丁汉森林）。

news.title: Watson and Ezenwata up for PL2 award
news.title_zh: Watson 和 Ezenwata 争夺 PL2 奖
news.body_en: Cobham Next Gen midfielder Reggie Watson and attacker Chizaram Ezenwata have both been shortlisted for September’s Premier League 2 Player of the Month award. 16-year-old Watson has been in superb form this month, scoring three goals in two PL2 matches. He netted a brace against Arsenal, leading Cobham Next Gen to a statement 4-1 win. First, he converted from the penalty spot before wrapping a free-kick into the far corner. Watson made an impact against Fulham, too, scoring the Blues’ second goal with a low drive into the bottom corner. That finish took his goal tally this season up to five in PL2. The mature midfielder has now featured on the scoresheet in each of CNG’s league matches this season, while at the beginning of the month, Watson made his senior debut, starting in midfield in our 6-3 win over Leeds United in the third round of the Carabao Cup. Blues striker Ezenwata has also been nominated for this month’s award having started the 2026/27 campaign promisingly. The 18-year-old scored the winner in CNG’s 5-4 win over West Ham, and netted in the win against Arsenal at the start of the month. Ezenwata then showcased his playmaking ability by claiming two assists to complete the 3-1 comeback win against West London rivals Fulham. He also came close to scoring his third league goal of the season in that match, striking the crossbar in the first half with an emphatic left-footed effort. Leo Black, who is currently on trial at Chelsea, also features in the shortlist following some impressive displays, including goals scored against Arsenal and Fulham. Watson’s and Ezenwata’s performances have earned them nominations for September’s Premier League 2 Player of the Month award, alongside Leo Black (Chelsea trialist), Will Wright (Liverpool), Cruz Ibeh (Middlebrough), Harvey Vincent (Leeds United), Charlie Dinsdale (Sunderland) and Tyrese Hall (Tottenham Hotspur). The winner of this month’s award will be announced on Friday 2 October.
news.body_zh: 科巴姆下一代中场球员雷吉·沃森和攻击手奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔均入围 9 月英超 2 月最佳球员奖。 16岁的沃森本月状态极佳，在两场联赛中攻入三球。他在对阵阿森纳的比赛中梅开二度，带领科巴姆下一代以 4-1 获胜。首先，他从点球点起脚射门，然后将任意球射入远角。沃森在对阵富勒姆的比赛中也发挥了重要作用，他低射入球底角，打进了蓝军的第二个进球。这一成绩使他本赛季的联赛第二进球数达到了五个。这位成熟的中场球员现在已经在CNG本赛季的每场联赛中都有进球，而在本月初，沃森首次在成年队亮相，在卡拉宝杯第三轮6-3战胜利兹联的比赛中，他在中场首发。蓝军前锋 Ezenwata 也因 2026/27 赛季的开局表现而获得本月奖项提名。这位18岁的球员在CNG 5-4战胜西汉姆联的比赛中攻入制胜球，并在本月初战胜阿森纳的比赛中攻入一球。随后，Ezenwata 展现了自己的组织能力，送出两次助攻，帮助球队 3-1 逆转战胜西伦敦对手富勒姆。在那场比赛中，他还差点打入本赛季的第三个联赛进球，上半场左脚大力射门击中横梁。目前正在切尔西接受试训的利奥·布莱克在一些令人印象深刻的表现（包括对阵阿森纳和富勒姆的进球）后也进入了候选名单。沃森和埃森瓦塔的表现为他们赢得了9月英超二号月度最佳球员的提名，与利奥·布莱克（切尔西试训者）、威尔·赖特（利物浦）、克鲁兹·伊贝（米德尔伯勒）、哈维·文森特（利兹联）、查理·丁斯代尔（桑德兰）和泰瑞斯·霍尔（托特纳姆热刺）一起提名。本月奖项的获奖者将于 10 月 2 日星期五公布。

news.title: Chelsea Women vs Arsenal: How to watch, kick-off time, live stream info
news.title_zh: 切尔西女足对阵阿森纳：如何观看、开球时间、直播信息
news.body_en: Chelsea Women host Arsenal in the Women's Super League on Sunday afternoon, in what promises to be an enthralling London derby. Two of women's football's biggest sides go head-to-head on Sunday as we take on the Gunners at Stamford Bridge. After our opening day draw against Aston Villa, we have gone on to record a 5-0 victory away at Manchester United and a 2-0 home win against Birmingham City last weekend. Meanwhile, Arsenal won 1-0 against Brighton & Hove Albion on the opening day, but have struggled in their last two league fixtures. A 0-0 draw at home to Crystal Palace was followed up with a 1-1 stalemate against Man United, as a 95th-minute goal from Smilla Holmberg rescued a point. Here is everything you need to know about how to watch Chelsea Women against Arsenal, including kick-off time and how to follow the action on official Chelsea channels. Chelsea Women's game against Arsenal takes place on Sunday 27 September 2026 at Stamford Bridge, with kick-off scheduled for 4.30pm UK time. The best way to experience the unique atmosphere at the London derby is by coming to the Bridge in person. Tickets for the game are available here. There are a number of special initiatives planned for the day, as supporters are encouraged to make it a 'Blue Day' on Sunday, and you can find out more about that here. If you are unable to join us, then you can watch the match live on Sky One, Sky Sports Main Event and Sky Sports Premier League. As always, team news, live updates and match coverage will be provided in our Chelsea Women vs Arsenal Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and Chelsea website. You can also follow along via Chelsea Women’s social media channels on X, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok. This Sunday’s game at Stamford Bridge is matchday four in this season’s WSL and is between the sides third and sixth in the table. Chelsea have two points more than Arsenal and trail leaders Manchester City by two points. Chelsea (11 games) and Arsenal (20 games) are on the two longest unbeaten runs in the WSL currently. Since the start of Chelsea’s run on matchday 15 last term (7 February onwards), the Blues average the most points per game in the top flight (2.64), ahead of the Gunners (2.50). Chelsea are unbeaten in each of our past 45 WSL matches when leading at any stage (W38 D7), the longest run in the competition’s history. Arsenal, meanwhile, are unbeaten in their last 42 when ahead (W38 D4), one off their own record run of 43 set between August 2016 and September 2019. This will be the 10th meeting between Chelsea and Arsenal in all competitions since the 2023/24 season, with both teams picking up four wins apiece in that time (with one draw). Arsenal were 2-0 victors in the league at Stamford Bridge against us last season, but not since the first three WSL campaigns (between 2011 and 2013) have they won consecutive WSL away matches versus the Blues. The WSL match at the Emirates last campaign ended 1-1, with Alyssa Thompson putting the Blues ahead early on followed by a late Alessia Russo equaliser. Last season, Chelsea also played Arsenal in the Champions League quarter-finals, exiting 3-2 on aggregate. Lauren James scored in a 3-1 first-leg defeat away and Sjoeke Nusken netted the only goal late on at Stamford Bridge. Chelsea (13 wins) and Arsenal (10 wins) is the most played fixture in WSL history (31 meetings including the 2017 Spring Series).
news.body_zh: 周日下午，切尔西女足将在女足超级联赛中主场迎战阿森纳，这场伦敦德比有望成为一场精彩的比赛。周日，女足两支最大的球队将在斯坦福桥迎战枪手。揭幕战战平阿斯顿维拉后，我们客场5-0战胜曼联，上周末主场2-0战胜伯明翰城。与此同时，阿森纳在揭幕战中以 1-0 战胜布莱顿，但在最近两场联赛中表现不佳。主场0-0战平水晶宫后，曼联1-1战平，斯米拉·霍姆伯格第95分钟的进球挽救了一分。以下是您需要了解的有关如何观看切尔西女足对阵阿森纳的所有信息，包括开球时间以及如何关注切尔西官方频道的比赛。切尔西女足对阵阿森纳的比赛将于 2026 年 9 月 27 日星期日在斯坦福桥举行，开球时间定于英国时间下午 4 点 30 分。体验伦敦德比独特氛围的最佳方式就是亲自来到桥上。比赛门票可在此处购买。这一天计划有许多特别活动，鼓励支持者将周日定为“蓝色日”，您可以在此处了解更多相关信息。如果您无法加入我们，您可以在 Sky One、Sky Sports Main Event 和 Sky Sports Premier League 上观看比赛直播。与往常一样，球队新闻、实时更新和比赛报道将在切尔西官方应用程序和切尔西网站上的切尔西女足对阵阿森纳比赛中心提供。您还可以通过 X、Facebook、Instagram 和 TikTok 上的 Chelsea Women 社交媒体渠道进行关注。本周日在斯坦福桥举行的比赛是本赛季 WSL 的第四轮比赛，双方在积分榜上排名第三和第六。切尔西比阿森纳多两分，落后领头羊曼城两分。切尔西（11 场比赛）和阿森纳（20 场比赛）是目前 WSL 中最长不败纪录的两支球队。自上赛季切尔西第 15 轮比赛开始（2 月 7 日起）以来，蓝军在顶级联赛中场均得分最高（2.64），领先于枪手（2.50）。过去 45 场 WSL 比赛中，切尔西在任何阶段领先的情况下均保持不败（38 胜 7 平），这是该赛事历史上最长的连续纪录。与此同时，阿森纳在过去 42 场比赛中保持不败（38 胜 4 平），这是他们在 2016 年 8 月至 2019 年 9 月期间创下的 43 场不败纪录中的一员。这将是自​​ 2023/24 赛季以来切尔西和阿森纳在所有比赛中第 10 次交锋，两队当时各取得 4 场胜利（1 场平局）。上赛季，阿森纳在斯坦福桥联赛中以 2-0 战胜了我们，但自前三个 WSL 赛季（2011 年至 2013 年）以来，他们还没有连续赢过 WSL 客场对阵蓝军的比赛。上赛季在酋长球场举行的 WSL 比赛以 1-1 结束，阿丽莎·汤普森 (Alyssa Thompson) 早早帮助蓝军取得领先，随后阿莱西亚·鲁索 (Alessia Russo) 扳平比分。上赛季，切尔西还在欧冠四分之一决赛中对阵阿森纳，总比分3-2出局。首回合客场 1-3 失利的比赛中，劳伦·詹姆斯 (Lauren James) 攻入一球，而舍克·努斯肯 (Sjoeke Nusken) 在斯坦福桥的比赛中攻入唯一进球。切尔西（13 场胜利）和阿森纳（10 场胜利）是 WSL 历史上出场次数最多的比赛（包括 2017 年春季系列赛在内的 31 场比赛）。

news.title: Chelsea's Ultimate Goal of the Season: Group B vote
news.title_zh: 切尔西本赛季的终极进球：B组投票
news.body_en: Our search for Chelsea’s Ultimate Goal of the Season continues and Group B has a distinctly Brazilian flavour. After Group A got the competition under way, five more Goal of the Season winners now go head-to-head for two places in the quarter-finals. This time, every contender was scored by a Brazilian Blue, with Juliano Belletti, Ramires, Oscar, Willian and Joao Pedro providing the five moments for you to choose between. There are an array of different goals, with a long-range thunderbolt, an unforgettable chip on one of the biggest nights in our history, a moment of individual brilliance, a wonderful team move and an overhead kick. As with Group A, the two goals which receive the most votes will advance to the quarter-finals, as our field of 20 previous winners is gradually narrowed down on the way to crowning the Ultimate Goal of the Season. The decision over which Brazilian beauties make it through is in your hands. You can watch all five Group B contenders below, relive some memorable moments and pick the two goals you want to see progress by voting over on the Chelsea Official App. Cast your vote for our Ultimate Goal of the Season on the Chelsea Official App here Tottenham afforded Belletti acres of space as he advanced from well inside his own half and the Brazilian made them pay in spectacular fashion, unleashing a thunderous drive from 35 yards, which flew into the top corner at the Shed End. On an unforgettable Champions League night at the Nou Camp, Ramires raced on to Frank Lampard’s perfectly weighted pass and produced an audacious first-time chip over Victor Valdes to put us ahead in the tie on away goals. We of course went on to win our first Champions League that year, making this goal all the more memorable. On his first Chelsea start, Oscar announced himself in style. With his back to goal on the edge of the box, he took a fantastic touch from Ashley Cole's pass, spinning away from two Juventus players before curling a magnificent effort beyond Gianluigi Buffon and into the top corner. A goal to give the word teamwork a new meaning. Willian exchanged a series of quick passes with Eden Hazard and Michy Batshuayi, in the process slicing through the Brighton defence, before firing home from the edge of the penalty area. Joao Pedro brought up the 20th goal of his debut Chelsea season in spectacular style, controlling Marc Cucurella’s header on his chest before producing an acrobatic overhead kick, which flew beyond Matz Sels and into the far corner. Cast your vote for our Ultimate Goal of the Season on the Chelsea Official App here
news.body_zh: 我们继续寻找切尔西本赛季的终极进球，B 组具有明显的巴西风味。 A组比赛开始后，另外五名赛季最佳进球得主将在四分之一决赛中争夺两个席位。这一次，每位参赛者都由巴西蓝军进球，朱利亚诺·贝莱蒂、拉米雷斯、奥斯卡、威廉和若昂·佩德罗提供了五个时刻供您选择。有一系列不同的进球，包括远距离雷电、在我们历史上最伟大的夜晚之一令人难忘的切入、个人的辉煌时刻、精彩的团队动作和倒钩球。与 A 组一样，得票最多的两个进球将晋级四分之一决赛，我们在争夺本赛季终极进球的道路上逐渐缩小了前 20 名获胜者的范围。巴西美女能否晋级的决定权掌握在您的手中。您可以观看下面所有五支 B 组竞争者的比赛，重温一些难忘的时刻，并通过在切尔西官方应用程序上投票来选择您希望看到进展的两个进球。热刺为贝莱蒂从本方半场内推进提供了数英亩的空间，巴西人以惊人的方式让他们付出了代价，从 35 码处发出雷鸣般的射门，飞入谢德恩德的上角。在诺坎普球场度过的一个难忘的欧冠之夜，拉米雷斯接到弗兰克·兰帕德完美的传球后，第一次大胆地突破维克多·巴尔德斯，帮助我们在客场进球数上领先。当然，我们在那一年赢得了我们的第一个欧冠冠军，这让这个进球更加令人难忘。在切尔西的首次首发中，奥斯卡展现出了自己的风格。他在禁区边缘背对球门，接到阿什利·科尔的传球后，他一脚漂亮的触球，摆脱了两名尤文图斯球员的防守，然后将一脚漂亮的射门越过吉安路易吉·布冯射入球门上角。一个目标是赋予团队合作这个词新的含义。威廉与阿扎尔和巴舒亚伊进行了一系列快速传球，在此过程中突破了布莱顿的防守，然后从禁区边缘射门破门。若昂·佩德罗以精彩的风格打进了他在切尔西的首个赛季的第20个进球，他控制了马克·库库雷拉的头球，然后踢出一记杂技般的倒钩球，球越过马茨·塞尔斯飞入远角。在切尔西官方应用程序上为我们本赛季的终极进球投票

news.title: Internationals: Neto helps Portugal to winning start
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：内托帮助葡萄牙取得胜利
news.body_en: Pedro Neto helped Portugal begin their Nations League campaign with a 1-0 victory over Wales. Neto started for Portugal at the Estadio Jose Alvalade in Lisbon as new head coach Jorge Jesus marked his first match in charge with three points. It was former Blue Joao Felix who broke the deadlock midway through the first half. His effort from outside the penalty area took a deflection off Ben Davies to beat Wales goalkeeper Danny Ward, and ultimately proved enough to settle the contest. Portugal were more dominant than the scoreline suggested, having 23 shots at goal to Wales' five and Neto created an opening which saw a Ronaldo effort easily saved by Ward. The former Real Madrid and Manchester United man had the ball in the back of the net early in the second half but the goal was ruled out for offside. Elsewhere, Jorrel Hato remained on the bench as the Netherlands left it late to secure a 1-1 draw with Germany in Amsterdam. Felix Nmecha put the visitors ahead after 32 minutes, but Cody Gakpo struck in the second minute of stoppage time to earn the hosts a point in their Nations League opener. Both nations are back in action on Sunday, with Hato’s Netherlands travelling to Serbia before Neto and Portugal take on Norway in Oslo.
news.body_zh: 佩德罗·内托帮助葡萄牙以 1-0 战胜威尔士，开启了欧国联征程。内托在里斯本的何塞阿尔瓦拉德球场为葡萄牙队首发，新任主教练豪尔赫·热苏斯在他执教的第一场比赛中拿下三分。上半场中段，前蓝军球员若昂·菲利克斯打破僵局。他在禁区外的射门击中了本戴维斯的射门，击败了威尔士门将丹尼沃德，最终证明足以解决比赛问题。葡萄牙队比比分显示的更具统治力，有 23 次射门，威尔士只有 5 次射门，内托创造了一个空档，罗纳尔多的射门被沃德轻松扑出。这位前皇马和曼联球员在下半场一开始就将球打入网内，但进球因越位而被判无效。其他方面，哈托（Jorrel Hato）仍然坐在替补席上，荷兰队在阿姆斯特丹以 1-1 战平德国队。菲利克斯·恩梅查 (Felix Nmecha) 在第 32 分钟帮助客队取得领先，但科迪·加克波 (Cody Gakpo) 在补时第二分钟的进球为东道主在欧国联首场比赛中赢得一分。两国队将于周日重返赛场，哈托的荷兰队将前往塞尔维亚，然后内托和葡萄牙队将在奥斯陆迎战挪威队。

news.title: Alyssa Thompson on 'fighting it out' and starting strong in the Women's Champions League
news.title_zh: 艾莉莎·汤普森谈“奋力拼搏”并在女子冠军联赛中强势起步
news.body_en: Cast your mind back to our first Women’s Champions League match of last season. We played away at FC Twente, a team we were expected to beat comfortably, but only came away with a 1-1 draw. That result, coupled with a well-earned 1-1 stalemate against Barcelona at Stamford Bridge, meant that it came down to the last league phase match – a difficult test away at Wolfsburg – to ensure that we made it straight through to the knockout stage without having to play an extra two-legged knockout tie. And as Alyssa Thompson pointed out after our 1-0 win over Austria Vienna on Wednesday night, we are now in a better position than we were one year ago, even if the performance wasn’t one that will live long in supporters’ memories. Results in the next five league phase games are not guaranteed of course, especially with a difficult test to come away at Lyon - Sonia Bompastor’s former side. Yet all we could do last night was put three points on the board, and that’s exactly what we did. Thompson was keen to point this out after the final whistle, and described how the team dug in to secure a victory which could prove to be vital come mid-December, when the UWCL league phase concludes. ‘They were a good opponent, definitely physical,’ she said. ‘But we got the win in the end. We wanted to start the campaign with three points. We didn't do that last year, so we're starting off better than we did. ‘We had to play a little bit to their game at the end, but we won that battle, and we got the three points. We were ready for the physical fight. It turned into that, and then we knew what game we had to play. We're strong, and we know we can play different styles, so in the end we just had to fight it out. ‘We have a deep squad, and we're ready,' added Thompson. 'We showed our fight, and we have a lot of technical ability too, so once we start finishing our chances, we'll be great. ‘It's still early, but we're definitely clicking. We’ve had some injuries too, so once we get everyone back, I feel like we have a super deep squad. We're able to win games, and I think we've been playing well together, connecting, and doing well physically. ‘I feel great with the team that we have, and we know we can put up a fight and play in these physical games.' Thompson put in a strong performance on the night with three shots on goal, two of which were on target. She also completed ten passes in the final third of the pitch, dribbled the ball successfully six times (the most of any Chelsea player), won both tackles she attempted, and recovered the ball from the opposition on both occasions. Yet elite players are always looking for more from their performances, and afterwards she felt like she could’ve scored from her attempts, even though they only produced an xG (expected goals) rating of 0.12. ‘I feel like I could've finished my chances,’ Thompson continued. ‘As a forward, I always want to contribute either a goal or an assist, so I feel like I could do better in that for the team. But it was a physical game, so I did the best that I could to try to hold up the ball for the team, move the ball forward and things like that to get the win. ‘It was great for us to get the win, and it gives us a lot of momentum going into this weekend. All the girls just need to rest and recover, and we'll be good. We'll be fresh. I think we're going to play so many different teams and styles during the Champions League, so every test is great for us, and we came out with the three points, so it was a good one.’
news.body_zh: 让你的思绪回到我们上赛季的第一场女子冠军联赛比赛。我们客场对阵特温特队，本以为可以轻松击败这支球队，但最终只以 1-1 战平。这个结果，再加上在斯坦福桥与巴塞罗那队1-1平局，意味着我们必须在联赛阶段的最后一场比赛——客场对阵沃尔夫斯堡的一场艰难考验——才能确保我们直接进入淘汰赛阶段，而无需进行额外的两回合淘汰赛。正如艾莉莎·汤普森在周三晚上 1-0 战胜奥地利维也纳后指出的那样，我们现在的处境比一年前更好，即使这场表现不会长久留在支持者的记忆中。当然，接下来的五场联赛阶段比赛的结果并不能保证，尤其是在客场对阵索尼娅·邦帕斯托的前东家里昂的艰难考验。然而昨晚我们所能做的就是在板上拿下三分，而这正是我们所做的。汤普森在终场哨响后热衷于指出这一点，并描述了球队如何努力确保胜利，这对于 12 月中旬 UWCL 联赛阶段结束时至关重要。 “他们是一个很好的对手，绝对是身体上的，”她说。 ‘但我们最终取得了胜利。我们希望以三分开始这场比赛。去年我们没有这样做，所以我们的起步比以前更好。 “最后我们不得不跟上他们的节奏，但我们赢了那场比赛，拿到了三分。我们已经做好了身体对抗的准备。事情变成了这样，然后我们就知道我们必须玩什么游戏了。我们很强大，而且我们知道我们可以打出不同的风格，所以最后我们只能拼尽全力。 “我们有一支深度阵容，我们已经准备好了，”汤普森补充道。 “我们展示了我们的战斗力，我们也有很多技术能力，所以一旦我们开始完成我们的机会，我们就会很棒。 “现在还为时过早，但我们肯定会取得进展。我们也有一些伤病，所以一旦我们让所有人都回来，我觉得我们有一个超级深度的阵容。我们能够赢得比赛，我认为我们在一起踢得很好，相互配合，身体素质也很好。 “我对我们的球队感觉很好，我们知道我们可以在这些体育比赛中奋力拼搏。”汤普森当晚表现出色，三脚射门，其中两次射正。她还在球场的最后三分之一处完成了十次传球，六次成功带球（是所有切尔西球员中最多的），两次尝试都成功了，并两次从对手手中夺回了球。然而，精英球员总是从自己的表现中寻求更多，事后她觉得自己可以从自己的尝试中得分，尽管他们的xG（预期进球）评分仅为0.12。 “我觉得我已经完成了我的机会，”汤普森继续说道。 “作为一名前锋，我总是想贡献一个进球或一次助攻，所以我觉得我可以在这方面为球队做得更好。但这是一场身体对抗的比赛，所以我尽了最大努力为球队控球、向前推进等等，以赢得胜利。 “赢得胜利对我们来说很棒，这给了我们进入这个周末的动力。所有的女孩都需要休息和恢复，我们会没事的。我们就会有新鲜感。我认为我们在冠军联赛期间将对阵许多不同的球队和风格，所以每一次测试对我们来说都很棒，我们拿下了三分，所以这是一个很好的测试。

news.title: Internationals: Grimwade and Henry help England U17s to dominant win
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：格里姆韦德和亨利帮助英格兰U17队取得统治性胜利
news.body_en: Chelsea duo Heze Grimwade and Josh Henry scored for England U17s to help Barry Lewtas’ side to a 5-1 win against Republic of Ireland at St George’s Park. The Young Lions were captained by Chelsea’s Reggie Watson and dominated the contest, giving them a vital boost ahead of their trip to Germany for a three-match tournament. Grimwade (pictured top) broke the deadlock in the 23rd minute with an outstanding left-footed half-volley. His fantastic strike kissed the right post on its way into the back of the net to hand England the initial advantage. In the second half, the floodgates opened and fellow Chelsea Under-18 player Henry got his name on the scoresheet. The centre-half extended England’s lead, converting his team-mate’s cross with a well-taken header to make it 3-0. Lewtas’ side will now head to Wedau, Duisburg to face Israel, Venezuela and hosts Germany. Over in Alicante, Alfie Osborne captained Scotland Under-19s as they beat Finland 3-1 under new Head Coach Tam Courts. The summer signing is set to feature in a total of three friendly matches in this international break. Up next, Scotland will face Czechia before concluding their Spanish tour with a game against Ukraine.
news.body_zh: 切尔西二人组赫泽·格里姆韦德和约什·亨利为英格兰 U17 队进球，帮助巴里·卢塔斯的球队在圣乔治公园以 5-1 战胜爱尔兰共和国。幼狮队由切尔西队的雷吉·沃森担任队长，统治了比赛，为他们前往德国参加三场比赛之前提供了重要的推动力。格里姆韦德（上图）在第23分钟以一脚出色的左脚半抽射打破僵局。他的精彩射门在进入网后时亲吻了右门柱，为英格兰队带来了最初的优势。下半场，闸门打开，切尔西 18 岁以下球员亨利的名字出现在进球表上。这位中后卫扩大了英格兰队的领先优势，他接队友的传中，头球攻门，将比分改写为3-0。莱塔斯的球队现在将前往杜伊斯堡韦杜迎战以色列、委内瑞拉和东道主德国。在阿利坎特，阿尔菲·奥斯本 (Alfie Osborne) 担任苏格兰 19 岁以下国家队队长，在新任主教练塔姆·考特斯 (Tam Courts) 的带领下，苏格兰 3-1 击败芬兰。这名夏季签约球员将在国际比赛日期间参加总共三场友谊赛。接下来，苏格兰将迎战捷克队，然后以一场对阵乌克兰的比赛结束他们的西班牙之旅。

news.title: Chelsea’s Ultimate Goal of the Season: Group A results
news.title_zh: 切尔西本赛季的终极目标：A 组结果
news.body_en: The results are in for the opening round of Chelsea's Ultimate Goal of the Season competition, with Michael Essien and Eden Hazard securing the top two spots in Group A to progress to the quarter-finals. The vote, featuring five spectacular strikes spanning two decades of Goal of the Season winners, was contested on the Chelsea Official App and it was Essien and Hazard who came out on top. Both goals were iconic late equalisers against London rivals at Stamford Bridge. Essien’s swerving bolt from the blue earned us a point in a 1-1 draw with Arsenal, while Hazard’s unstoppable top-corner finish against Tottenham sealed the fate of the title race in 2016. The two winners beat off Goal of the Season winners from Oscar (2015), Fikayo Tomori (2020), and Pedro Neto (2025). The hunt for Chelsea’s Ultimate Goal of the Season continues tomorrow (Friday) as we open the polls for Group B, so you make sure you log back in to the Chelsea Official App to watch the contenders and cast your vote!
news.body_zh: 切尔西赛季终极进球比赛的首轮比赛结果已出炉，迈克尔·埃辛和伊登·阿扎尔包揽了 A 组前两名，晋级四分之一决赛。此次投票在切尔西官方应用程序上进行，其中包括二十年来赛季最佳进球得主的五次精彩进球，最终埃辛和阿扎尔脱颖而出。在斯坦福桥对阵伦敦对手的比赛中，这两个进球都是标志性的最后时刻扳平比分的进球。埃辛的灵光一闪为我们在 1-1 战平阿森纳的比赛中赢得一分，而阿扎尔在对阵托特纳姆热刺的比赛中不可阻挡的上角射门决定了 2016 年冠军争夺战的命运。这两位获奖者击败了奥斯卡（2015 年）、菲卡约·托莫里（2020 年）和佩德罗·内托（2025 年）的赛季最佳进球得主。明天（周五）我们将继续争夺切尔西赛季最佳进球，届时我们将开启 B 组投票，因此请务必重新登录切尔西官方应用程序，观看竞争者并投票！

news.title: Morgan Rogers CFC Unlocked out now!
news.title_zh: 摩根罗杰斯 CFC 现已解锁！
news.body_en: The latest episode of CFC Unlocked is now available exclusively for CFC+ subscribers to watch, with Morgan Rogers sharing how the most important period of his career so far shaped him as a footballer as part of a wide-ranging interview. Rogers joined us in the CFC Unlocked studio at Cobham for an in-depth chat, showing off his Premier League knowledge with some quiz games and trying to solve Chelsea supporters’ personal dilemmas. In the new episode, which CFC+ subscribers can watch in full below, Rogers discussed a wide range of subjects, including why he is so determined to make an impact in every game and how being a ball boy at West Bromwich Albion as a child inspired him to become a footballer. He also reflected on his start to life with the Blues since joining in the summer and the journey that has brought him to Stamford Bridge, highlighting one period of his career as particularly important. That came when he got his first taste of regular senior football in a series of loans from Manchester City. He spent time in the Football League at Lincoln City, Bournemouth and Blackpool before joining Championship side Middlesbrough permanently, eventually returning to the Premier League with Aston Villa and now Chelsea. ‘That was everything,’ he explains, when asked how those loan spells influenced his development. ‘I needed that next challenge, that next step. I needed to get out my comfort zone and kind of find the player I was going to be in professional football. ‘I think the academy player that I was, if you watch me then, I don't think it's the same player that you see now week to week. ‘I'm a completely different player and I had to learn that on loan, because academy football can be good to a certain extent and can teach you tricks of the trade and all the technical sides of it, because football's football. ‘But the actual way the game is played, the desire from the other team to win, what it takes, what teams are willing to do, how they're willing to play to win games, you can't replicate that in academy football. It's only in men's football. ‘For me to get that experience so young and so early allowed me to kind of move on and move up with time, so that when I was ready to make the next step up, I'd had experiences of the good and the bad to be able to deal with knocks and to be able to deal with playing in different types of ways. ‘So I think that really helped me be me. I think everyone's path is different. I wasn't ready. I needed time to develop, to learn, to understand myself more and to be here now at the level I know I can get to.’ CFC+ subscribers can watch the full episode with Morgan Rogers above and find the rest of the CFC Unlocked archive here. If you aren't already subscribed, here is all the information you need on CFC+ and how to sign up to get access to exclusive content and live football.
news.body_zh: 最新一集的《CFC Unlocked》现已专供 CFC+ 订阅者观看，摩根·罗杰斯在一次内容广泛的采访中分享了迄今为止他职业生涯中最重要的一段时期如何塑造了他作为一名足球运动员的形象。罗杰斯与我们在科巴姆的 CFC Unlocked 工作室进行了深入的交谈，通过一些问答游戏展示了他的英超知识，并试图解决切尔西球迷的个人困境。在新一集中（CFC+订阅者可以在下面完整观看），罗杰斯讨论了广泛的主题，包括为什么他如此决心在每场比赛中产生影响，以及小时候在西布罗姆维奇队担任球童如何激励他成为一名足球运动员。他还回顾了自夏季加盟以来他在蓝军的开始生活以及将他带到斯坦福桥的旅程，强调他职业生涯中的一个时期尤为重要。当他从曼城租借了一系列球员后，第一次尝到了正规成年足球的滋味。他曾在林肯城、伯恩茅斯和布莱克浦的足球联赛中效力过，然后永久加盟英冠球队米德尔斯堡，最终随阿斯顿维拉和现在的切尔西重返英超联赛。当被问及这些租借期如何影响他的发展时，他解释道：“这就是一切。” “我需要下一个挑战，下一步。我需要走出自己的舒适区，找到自己想要成为职业足球的球员。 “我认为我是一名青训球员，如果你当时看我，我不认为你现在每周看到的是同一个球员。 “我是一个完全不同的球员，我必须通过租借来学习这一点，因为学院足球在某种程度上可以很好，可以教你交易技巧和所有技术方面，因为足球就是足球。” “但是比赛的实际方式，对方球队对胜利的渴望，需要什么，球队愿意做什么，他们愿意如何踢球来赢得比赛，你无法在学院足球中复制这些。这仅适用于男子足球。 “对我来说，如此年轻、如此早地获得这种经验，让我能够继续前进，随着时间的推移而进步，这样，当我准备好迈出下一步时，我就已经经历过好的和坏的，能够应对敲击，并能够以不同类型的方式应对比赛。 “所以我认为这确实帮助我成为了我自己。我想每个人的路都是不同的。我还没准备好。我需要时间来发展、学习、更多地了解自己，并达到我知道自己能达到的水平。CFC+ 订阅者可以观看上面摩根·罗杰斯的完整剧集，并在此处找到 CFC Unlocked 档案的其余部分。如果您尚未订阅，这里有您需要的有关 CFC+ 的所有信息以及如何注册以获得独家内容和现场足球比赛的信息。

news.title: Chelsea Foundation extends grants helping to tackle homelessness
news.title_zh: 切尔西基金会提供赠款帮助解决无家可归问题
news.body_en: Chelsea Foundation is extending its Wrap Up Warm grants for a further year, providing a combined £75,000 of unrestricted funding to three local charities supporting people experiencing homelessness across south-west London and Surrey. The funding will continue Chelsea Foundation’s partnerships with Barons Court Project, Vineyard Community and York Road Project, enabling the organisations to build on the impact achieved during the first year of the grants which was provided through the funds raised Chelsea Football Club and Chelsea Foundation’s Wrap Up Warm campaign. The partnerships will provide vital support to those experiencing homelessness, poverty and social exclusion, as homelessness continues to be a significant and growing issue across local communities, with charities seeing increasing levels of need and demand for their services. Laura Cordingley, Chief Executive of Chelsea Foundation, said: ‘Homelessness is one of the most pressing challenges facing communities across London and Surrey, and is something we know is affecting people within the communities closest to us. ‘Through our Wrap Up Warm grants, we are able to support organisations that are already making a tangible difference, helping them respond to immediate need while also creating opportunities for people to move towards greater stability and independence. Extending these grants for another year allows us to build on the strong partnerships we have established and continue supporting people who are often among the most vulnerable in our communities.’ ‘Without the support and generosity of our club, supporters and partners, the Foundation wouldn’t be able to provide these much-needed grants. It’s brilliant to see the impact that we can have collectively that helps enable the Foundation to provide longer-term support to people who need it most.’ Levi Colwill has seen first-hand the impact of Chelsea Foundation’s vital partnerships. He visited Barons Court Project in 2024 as part of the Wrap Up Warm campaign and returned to Stamford Bridge in 2025 to support the Foundation’s Christmas lunch, bringing together people experiencing loneliness during the festive period including beneficiaries of the three organisations. Colwill commented on the grants: 'Homelessness is something I’ve always felt really passionate about, so it’s brilliant that Chelsea Foundation is supporting such important work in our local communities. I’ve been lucky enough to see the work of Barons Court Project first-hand and understand the difference organisations like this can make to people’s lives. It’s fantastic that the Foundation is extending its support to Barons Court Project, Vineyard Community and York Road Project, and I’m sure these partnerships will have a significant impact within our community.' Founded in 2011, Richmond-based Vineyard Community supports people experiencing homelessness, poverty and social exclusion, helping around 7,000 people each year through a range of crisis and community services. These include homelessness support, casework, foodbank provision and community drop-in services. The Wrap Up Warm grant will enable Vineyard Community to expand its mental health support and strengthen its holistic services, helping individuals and families improve their circumstances. The funding will also support the launch of a new Community Essentials Hub, due to open later this year, providing people with access to essential items in a dignified and welcoming environment. David Logan, Vineyard Community & Richmond Foodbank CEO, said: ‘We’re honoured to receive this empowering grant and to partner with such a visionary organisation. This support strengthens our shared commitment to transforming lives, restoring hope, and building brighter futures for those who need it most. Together, we’re bringing our mission of “Help in Crisis, Hope for Life” to life across our communities.’ Barons Court Project was established in 1985 by psychiatrists and social workers who recognised a lack of support for people experiencing homelessness and mental health challenges in west London. Today, it is the only dedicated day centre of its kind in the London Borough of Hammersmith & Fulham, supporting people who are homeless, on low incomes or vulnerable due to poor mental health. The Wrap Up Warm grant is helping the organisation progress ambitious plans to improve its centre and create additional space for the people it supports. Building work is getting underway to convert the loft into a purpose-built art studio and group work room, creating a welcoming space where guests can relax, connect with others and rebuild their lives. Michael Angus, Barons Court Project CEO, commented: ‘The Chelsea Foundation were our first significant funder when we launched an appeal last year to undertake major building works at our centre. We are about to commence those works. The additional grant, awarded for next year, will ensure we can fit out our new spaces beautifully, and ensure we provide the best home for people without one or who may not feel at home within themselves. We remain deeply grateful for their support.’ Founded in 1995 as Woking Winter Watch and registered as a charity in 2001, York Road Project works with people experiencing homelessness to help them secure accommodation and rebuild their lives. Its tailored support addresses a range of challenges, including housing, mental health, addiction and employment. Alongside emergency accommodation, York Road Project operates a resource centre and move-on housing, providing both immediate support and longer-term pathways towards independence. The Wrap Up Warm grant is helping the charity provide vital support to people sleeping rough and those rebuilding their lives after homelessness. The funding will enable York Road Project to place a greater focus on mental health, life skills and empowering clients to move towards greater independence, helping people to move beyond simply finding accommodation and towards building a more secure future. Richard Eyres, York Road Project Fundraising Manager manager said:‘We’re absolutely delighted that the Chelsea Foundation are extending our funding into 2027. The Foundation’s support this last year has been essential as we tackle rising homelessness. We have been able to support our clients in a way that goes far beyond a roof over their head; equipping them to thrive tomorrow, not just to survive today. A client wrote earlier this month that “YRP saved me from homelessness”. This would not have been possible without Chelsea Foundation’s support, and with extended funding we can keep changing people’s lives over the next year.’ The Wrap Up Warm grants form part of Chelsea Foundation’s commitment to creating hyper-local impact and supporting communities across south-west London and Surrey. By working in partnership with organisations already embedded within these communities, the Foundation can help respond to issues where specialist local expertise is essential and where partnership funding can deliver meaningful, long-term impact.
news.body_zh: 切尔西基金会将其 Wrap Up Warm 赠款再延长一年，向三个当地慈善机构提供总计 75,000 英镑的无限制资金，以支持伦敦西南部和萨里的无家可归者。这笔资金将继续切尔西基金会与男爵庭院项目、葡萄园社区和约克路项目的合作关系，使这些组织能够在通过切尔西足球俱乐部和切尔西基金会的“Wrap Up Warm”活动筹集的资金提供的赠款第一年所取得的影响的基础上再接再厉。这些伙伴关系将为那些经历无家可归、贫困和社会排斥的人提供重要支持，因为无家可归仍然是当地社区一个重要且日益严重的问题，慈善机构对其服务的需求和需求不断增加。切尔西基金会首席执行官劳拉·科丁利 (Laura Cordingley) 表示：“无家可归是伦敦和萨里社区面临的最紧迫的挑战之一，我们知道，无家可归正在影响离我们最近的社区中的人们。 “通过我们的 Wrap Up Warm 赠款，我们能够支持那些已经产生切实影响的组织，帮助他们应对眼前的需求，同时也为人们创造机会，实现更大的稳定和独立。将这些赠款再延长一年，使我们能够在已经建立的强有力的合作伙伴关系的基础上继续发展，并继续支持我们社区中最弱势的人们。”“如果没有我们的俱乐部、支持者和合作伙伴的支持和慷慨，基金会将无法提供这些急需的赠款。很高兴看到我们共同产生的影响，帮助基金会为最需要的人提供长期支持。”利瓦伊·科尔威尔亲眼目睹了切尔西基金会重要合作伙伴关系的影响。作为 Wrap Up Warm 活动的一部分，他于 2024 年参观了 Barons Court 项目，并于 2025 年返回斯坦福桥支持基金会的圣诞午餐，将节日期间经历孤独的人们聚集在一起，其中包括三个组织的受益人。科尔威尔对这笔赠款发表了评论：“我一直对无家可归问题充满热情，因此切尔西基金会支持我们当地社区的此类重要工作真是太棒了。我很幸运能够亲眼目睹男爵法庭项目的工作，并了解这样的组织可以给人们的生活带来的改变。基金会将其支持扩展到男爵庭院项目、葡萄园社区和约克路项目，这真是太棒了，我相信这些合作伙伴关系将对我们的社区产生重大影响。”位于里士满的 Vineyard Community 成立于 2011 年，为无家可归、贫困和社会排斥的人们提供支持，每年通过一系列危机和社区服务帮助约 7,000 人。其中包括无家可归者支持、个案工作、食品银行提供和社区临时服务。 Wrap Up Warm 赠款将使葡萄园社区能够扩大其心理健康支持并加强其整体服务，帮助个人和家庭改善他们的情况。这笔资金还将支持启动一个新的社区必需品中心，该中心将于今年晚些时候开放，为人们提供在有尊严和热情的环境中获取必需品的机会。葡萄园社区和里士满食品银行首席执行官大卫·洛根 (David Logan) 表示：“我们很荣幸获得这笔资助，并与这样一个有远见的组织合作。这种支持加强了我们对改变生活、恢复希望以及为最需要帮助的人建设更光明的未来的共同承诺。我们共同将“危机中的帮助，生命的希望”的使命带入我们社区的生活中。Barons Court 项目由精神病学家和社会工作者于 1985 年创立，他们认识到伦敦西部无家可归和面临心理健康挑战的人们缺乏支持。如今，它是伦敦哈默史密斯和富勒姆区唯一的此类日间中心，为无家可归、低收入或因心理健康状况不佳而脆弱的人们提供支持。 Wrap Up Warm 赠款正在帮助该组织推进雄心勃勃的计划，以改善其中心并为其支持的人们创造更多空间。 建筑工程正在进行中，将阁楼改造成专门建造的艺术工作室和小组工作室，打造一个温馨的空间，让客人可以放松、与他人交流并重建他们的生活。男爵法庭项目首席执行官迈克尔·安格斯 (Michael Angus) 评论道：“去年我们发起呼吁，要求在我们的中心进行重大建筑工程时，切尔西基金会是我们的第一个重要资助者。我们即将开始这些工作。明年发放的额外拨款将确保我们能够漂亮地装修我们的新空间，并确保我们为没有家或可能感觉不自在的人提供最好的家。我们仍然对他们的支持深表感谢。” 约克路项目成立于 1995 年，当时名为沃金冬季观察组织 (Woking Winter Watch)，并于 2001 年注册为慈善机构，它与无家可归的人们合作，帮助他们获得住宿并重建生活。其量身定制的支持解决了一系列挑战，包括住房、心理健康、成瘾和就业。除了紧急住宿外，约克路项目还运营一个资源中心和移动住房，提供即时支持和实现独立的长期途径。 Wrap Up Warm 赠款正在帮助该慈善机构为露宿街头的人和无家可归后重建生活的人们提供重要支持。这笔资金将使约克路项目能够更加关注心理健康、生活技能，并帮助客户走向更大的独立性，帮助人们超越简单地寻找住宿的范围，并走向建立一个更安全的未来。约克路项目筹款经理理查德·艾尔斯 (Richard Eyres) 表示：“我们非常高兴切尔西基金会将资助期限延长至 2027 年。去年基金会的支持对于我们解决日益严重的无家可归问题至关重要。我们为客户提供的支持远远超出了他们的承受范围。使他们能够在明天蓬勃发展，而不仅仅是今天生存。本月早些时候，一位客户写道，“YRP 让我免于无家可归”。如果没有切尔西基金会的支持，这一切都是不可能实现的，通过提供更多资金，我们可以在明年继续改变人们的生活。“Wrap Up Warm 赠款是切尔西基金会致力于创造超本地影响力和支持伦敦西南部和萨里社区的承诺的一部分。通过与已经嵌入这些社区的组织合作，基金会可以帮助解决当地专业知识至关重要以及合作资金可以产生有意义的长期影响的问题。

news.title: PGA South League report: Chelsea Women Under-18s 8-0 Ipswich Town
news.title_zh: PGA 南联盟报告：切尔西 18 岁以下女子队 8-0 伊普斯维奇
news.body_en: Chelsea Women's Under-18s, who play in the PGA Under-21 Women's League, completed the first phase of our Professional Game Academy South League campaign with an 8-0 victory over Ipswich Town at Kingsmeadow. Sophie Leach, Tess Finn and Rebekah Pierce were on target before half-time, and Stevie Sinclair (pictured top) scored a second-half hat-trick before substitute Jahmya Putman added two more. Sinclair was involved in all three first-half goals, providing the assists for Leach and Pierce. Leanne Champ's side had most of the ball throughout and created many chances, and they also kept a clean sheet in this behind-closed-doors fixture. Chelsea opened the scoring after 20 minutes from a corner. Sinclair sent an inswinging delivery in from the left, and Leach made good movement in the box to rise and head across goal into the net. With half-time approaching, the Blues doubled our lead with another corner routine. Sinclair played it short to captain Gabi Storey and collected the return on the outside of the box before driving a pass across the six-yard area. Ipswich cleared the first ball, but Finn was in a good supporting position to regain possession. She took a touch to set herself and finished into the bottom right corner. The third goal came on the stroke of half-time. Emelia Addison's throw from high on the left found Sinclair's forward run. Her lofted cross was met by Pierce at the back post, and she finished low and hard first time past the goalkeeper. Champ made two changes at the break, with Annie Boichat and Keira Johnson replacing Addison and Storey. Three more followed on the hour as Amelia Fahey, Putman and Elise Christian came on for Chelsea N'Drin, Carla Gardiner and Pierce. Sadie Gregory won the ball from an Ipswich throw to start the move for the fourth goal on 67 minutes. Putman found Sinclair's run into a central area. The Ipswich defence got a touch as Sinclair tried to combine with Christian, but she reacted quickly to win it back and fire in from a wide angle. Our desire to win the ball back produced the fifth goal five minutes later. Christian pressed the Ipswich full-back after a goal kick, and Sinclair's pressure from behind forced a misplaced pass straight to Johnson. Johnson quickly found Sinclair, who took a touch on the edge of the box and curled past the goalkeeper with her left foot. Chelsea scored again within a minute. Leach won the first contact from the restart, and she combined with Boichat, Finn and Christian. Christian then advanced and played the ball over the top for Putman. The striker controlled well, took the ball past the onrushing goalkeeper and slotted into the empty net. Sinclair completed her hat-trick on 77 minutes. Boichat won the ball and found Johnson, who combined with Sinclair on the edge of the box. This time Sinclair struck powerfully into the goal with the outside of her right foot. Putman added her second seven minutes from time. Aysia Matabaro received the ball in our defensive third and switched the play long to Christian, whose first-time pass found Putman's central run. She took one touch and placed her finish across goal. The victory means Chelsea have completed our fixtures in the PGA South Division and sit top of the table with 15 points. We have scored 28 goals and conceded four. The result followed our first defeat of the season against Arsenal. The Blues now await the second phase of PGA fixtures in Division 1. Chelsea return to Women's National League Cup action on Sunday 27 September, when we travel to Maidenhead United for our final group game. A draw or a win would take the Blues through to the knockout stages. Chelsea (3-4-3): Freya Weeks; Emelia Addison (Annie Boichat 45), Sadie Gregory, Sophie Leach; Gabi Storey (c) (Keira Johnson 45), Tess Finn, Chelsea N'Drin (Amelia Fahey 60), Stevie Sinclair; Carla Gardiner (Jahmya Putman 60), Aysia Matabaro, Rebekah Pierce (Elise Christian 60)Scorers: Leach 20, Finn 40, Pierce 45, Sinclair 67, 72, 77, Putman 73, 83Booked: N'Drin 30Manager: Leanne Champ
news.body_zh: 参加 PGA 21 岁以下女子联赛的切尔西 18 岁以下女子队在 Kingsmeadow 以 8-0 战胜伊普斯维奇镇，完成了职业比赛学院南联赛第一阶段的比赛。半场结束前，索菲·利奇、泰丝·芬恩和丽贝卡·皮尔斯都射中了球门，史蒂维·辛克莱（上图）在下半场上演了帽子戏法，随后替补出场的贾米亚·普特曼又上演了两个帽子戏法。辛克莱参与了上半场全部三个进球，并为利奇和皮尔斯提供助攻。 Leanne Champ 的球队自始至终掌控着大部分球权并创造了很多机会，而且他们还在这场闭门比赛中保持了不失球。 20分钟后，切尔西通过角球首开纪录。辛克莱从左路送出一记内旋传球，利奇在禁区内做出了良好的动作，起身头球破门入网。随着半场结束的临近，蓝军通过另一个角球动作将我们的领先优势扩大了一倍。辛克莱（Sinclair）向队长加比·斯托里（Gabi Storey）短传，在禁区外接回球，然后将球传过六码区域。伊普斯维奇将第一个球解围，但芬恩处于良好的支援位置，重新夺回控球权。她轻轻一触，就定位到了右下角。第三个进球是在半场结束时打进的。埃米莉亚·艾迪生（Emelia Addison）从左侧高处投出一球，找到了辛克莱（Sinclair）的前插。她的高高传中被皮尔斯在后门柱接住，她第一次低沉而艰难地越过了门将。钱普在中场休息时做出了两项调整，安妮·博伊查特和凯拉·约翰逊取代了艾迪生和斯托里。每小时三场比赛之后，阿米莉亚·费伊 (Amelia Fahey)、普特曼 (Putman) 和埃莉斯·克里斯蒂安 (Elise Christian) 替补切尔西·恩德林 (Chelsea N'Drin)、卡拉·加德纳 (Carla Gardiner) 和皮尔斯 (Pierce)。第 67 分钟，萨迪·格雷戈里 (Sadie Gregory) 从伊普斯维奇 (Ipswich) 传球中接住球，开始攻入第四个进球。普特曼发现辛克莱跑进了中心区域。当辛克莱尔试图与克里斯蒂安配合时，伊普斯维奇的防守受到了触动，但她迅速反应，将球扳回，并从广角射门。五分钟后，我们夺回球权的愿望产生了第五个进球。克里斯蒂安在球门球后向伊普斯维奇的后卫施压，辛克莱尔从后面的压力迫使他将一个错位的传球直接传给了约翰逊。约翰逊很快找到了辛克莱，辛克莱在禁区边缘触球，左脚绕过门将。切尔西在一分钟内再次进球。利奇赢得了重新开始的第一次接触，她与博伊查特、芬恩和克里斯蒂安组合。随后克里斯蒂安向前推进，将球传给普特曼。前锋控制得很好，皮球越过冲上来的门将，射入空门。辛克莱在第77分钟完成帽子戏法。博沙特得球后找到约翰逊，后者与禁区边缘的辛克莱尔联手。这次辛克莱用右脚外侧有力地射门。普特曼在比赛结束后七分钟内完成了第二个比赛。艾西亚·马塔巴罗 (Aysia Matabaro) 在我们的防守三区接到球，并将长传球传给了克里斯蒂安 (Christian)，后者的第一次传球找到了普特曼 (Putman) 的中路跑动。她一脚触球，将球射入球门。这场胜利意味着切尔西已经完成了 PGA 南部赛区的比赛，并以 15 分位居榜首。我们打进了 28 个进球，丢了 4 个球。这是我们本赛季第一次输给阿森纳之后的结果。蓝军现在正在等待 PGA 一级比赛的第二阶段比赛。切尔西将于 9 月 27 日星期日重返女子国家联赛杯比赛，届时我们将前往梅登黑德联队参加最后一场小组赛。一场平局或一场胜利将使蓝军进入淘汰赛阶段。切尔西（3-4-3）：弗雷亚·维克斯； Emelia Addison（Annie Boichat 45）、Sadie Gregory、Sophie Leach； Gabi Storey (c)（Keira Johnson 45）、Tess Finn、Chelsea N'Drin（Amelia Fahey 60）、Stevie Sinclair；卡拉·加德纳 (Jahm​​ya Putman 60)、艾西亚·马塔巴罗 (Aysia Matabaro)、丽贝卡·皮尔斯 (Elise Christian 60) 得分手：利奇 20、芬恩 40、皮尔斯 45、辛克莱 67、72、77、普特曼 73、83 预订：N'Drin 30 经理：Leanne Champ

Supporters who hold a season ticket, membership or any supporters who are a junior (under 20) can claim one ticket free of charge for this fixture up until 12pm on Friday 23 October 2026. You can do this by logging into your online account and selecting a ticket under the Liverpool PL2 event. Tickets will be sold online only initially and will go off sale online on Saturday 24 October at 2pm. Tickets will also be available to purchase on matchday from the Kingsmeadow ticket office two hours prior to kick-off. All tickets are subject to availability. Only card payments will be accepted at the Kingsmeadow ticket office. PDF tickets will be sent via email and tickets will appear on the Chelsea Official App. All persons under the age of 16 will be required to attend the relevant area of the ground with, and sit in the ground next to, a person aged 18 years of age or over. Supporters who require accessible tickets can submit an application form available by clicking here during the selling period. Alternatively, you can call our Access Team on 0371 811 2012 or 0044 207 915 1950 (international callers) to reserve tickets and request further information. Personal assistant tickets can only be allocated using this process. Supporters can click here to apply for car parking from 10am on Tuesday 29 September. You are required to display your Blue Badge while parked at Kingsmeadow. news.title: Sjoeke Nusken reflects on Chelsea's winning culture and calls for fans' support against Arsenal
news.title_zh: 斯乔克·努斯肯反思切尔西的胜利文化并呼吁球迷支持对阵阿森纳的比赛
news.body_en: After she had reflected on a gritty team performance that clinched the win against Austria Vienna on Wednesday night, Sjoeke Nusken called for the Chelsea fans to get right behind the team when we face Arsenal this weekend. The only goal of the game against Vienna came from Wieke Kaptein’s thunderbolt from outside the penalty area, but the opposition showed no fear, and we needed to make some crucial defensive interventions to protect the clean sheet. While Nusken, who has been at Chelsea since 2023, acknowledged there is plenty that the team can improve on, she was satisfied that we got the job done ahead of Sunday’s London derby. ‘In the end, the win was important,’ she explained after the final whistle. ‘We needed to get the three points, and this is all we are playing for, to win. So it’s good that we kept the clean sheet and that we could win with a stunning goal. ‘It's always tough to play a team who did so well defensively. They played one-v-one over the whole pitch. It was really hard to find solutions, but we need to keep working on finding those solutions and scoring some more goals. ‘We are working a lot on crossing and finding the net. Maybe I had a situation that was the same as in training, but I missed the target, so I need to keep working on these kinds of things. But yeah, it's good to get in those situations. ‘It's always more difficult in the game, but we're practising this kind of connection.’ With the three points in the bag, focus immediately turns to recovery and preparation for Sunday’s huge game against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge. Nusken is under no illusions over the expectations of playing for Chelsea, a club with eight Women’s Super League titles already in our cabinet. Yet the squad cannot repeat these achievements without the support of our fans, and the midfielder called for as many people as possible to turn out and represent the blue side of London at Stamford Bridge. 'We’re looking forward to Sunday now,’ she continued. ‘We need to improve our performance, of course. We need to get our connections back on the field, but we can't wait to play Sunday against Arsenal. It's always a big game, and we always want to win. ‘We need to perform every week. This is Chelsea - we need to win every single game. That's what we want. That's our aim. And we want to compete in every competition, and of course, it’s hard, but we have a big squad. We have good quality in the whole squad, so we have enough players to do it. ‘It's nice to play at Stamford Bridge. We hope that a lot of fans are coming to support us. It's important for us that the fans have our backs. ‘I think it's good to make the step to Stamford Bridge now because you can see that women's football is developing, and we will hopefully get more fans. To see Stamford Bridge maybe full in the future, that would be amazing.’ Answer Sio's call to action and join us as we take on rivals Arsenal at Stamford Bridge! Secure your seat now...
news.body_zh: 在回顾周三晚上战胜奥地利维也纳队的坚韧球队表现后，舍克·努斯肯呼吁切尔西球迷在本周末对阵阿森纳时支持球队。对阵维也纳的比赛中唯一的进球来自维克·卡普坦在禁区外的雷霆万钧，但对手并没有表现出恐惧，我们需要进行一些关键的防守干预才能保住不失球。自 2023 年以来一直效力切尔西的努斯肯承认球队还有很多需要改进的地方，但她对我们在周日的伦敦德比之前完成的工作感到满意。 “最终，胜利很重要，”终场哨响后她解释道。 “我们需要拿到三分，这就是我们为胜利而战的全部。因此，我们能保持不失球是件好事，并且我们能够以令人惊叹的进球获胜。 “与一支防守表现如此出色的球队交手总是很困难。他们在整个球场上进行了一对一的比赛。找到解决方案确实很难，但我们需要继续努力寻找这些解决方案并取得更多进球。 “我们在传球和破网方面做了很多工作。也许我遇到了和训练中一样的情况，但我没有达到目标，所以我需要继续努力这些事情。但是，是的，处于这些情况是件好事。 “比赛总是更加困难，但我们正在练习这种联系。”拿到三分后，焦点立即转向恢复和准备周日在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的大型比赛。努斯肯对为切尔西效力的期望不抱任何幻想，我们的内阁中已经有八次女子超级联赛冠军。然而，如果没有球迷的支持，球队就无法重复这些成就，这位中场球员呼吁尽可能多的人在斯坦福桥代表伦敦蓝队出场。 “我们现在期待着周日，”她继续说道。 “当然，我们需要提高我们的表现。我们需要恢复球场上的联系，但我们迫不及待地想参加周日对阵阿森纳的比赛。这总是一场重要的比赛，我们总是想赢。 “我们每周都需要表演。这是切尔西——我们需要赢得每一场比赛。这就是我们想要的。这就是我们的目标。我们希望参加每场比赛，当然，这很困难，但我们有一支强大的阵容。我们整支球队的素质都很好，所以我们有足够的球员来做到这一点。 “在斯坦福桥踢球真是太好了。我们希望有很多粉丝来支持我们。球迷的支持对我们来说很重要。 “我认为现在踏入斯坦福桥是件好事，因为你可以看到女足正在发展，我们希望能得到更多的球迷。看到斯坦福桥未来可能爆满，那真是太棒了。’响应 Sio 的号召，加入我们，一起在斯坦福桥迎战死敌阿森纳！赶紧抢座位吧……
