news.title: Attacking midfielder voted Star of the Match against Austria Vienna!
news.title_zh: 攻击型中场当选对阵奥地利维也纳的比赛之星！
news.body_en: Chelsea battled to a 1-0 victory over Austria Vienna in our Women's Champions League opener and Blues fans have voted for the standout performer from Wednesday evening's match. Vienna came to Plough Lane and made things difficult, but a moment of magic from Wieke Kaptein, some excellent saves from Livia Peng and a strong defensive display meant we came away with a win. Kaptein has been voted as your Star of the Match, taking a 49 per cent share of the votes for her excellent performance and stunning strike. Coming in second place with 32 per cent of the votes was Livia Peng, who made five saves in the second half, and defender Katie McCabe took third position with 13 per cent of the overall tally.
news.body_zh: 切尔西在女足冠军联赛揭幕战中以 1-0 战胜奥地利维也纳，蓝军球迷投票选出了周三晚上比赛中表现出色的球员。维也纳队来到普劳巷队，给比赛带来了困难，但维克·卡普坦的神奇时刻、彭丽媛的一些精彩扑救以及强大的防守表现意味着我们赢得了一场胜利。卡普坦因出色的表现和惊人的进球获得了 49% 的选票，被评选为本场比赛之星。彭莉以32%的得票率位居第二，她在下半场做出了5次扑救，后卫凯蒂·麦凯布以13%的得票率位居第三。

news.title: The Famous CFC is coming to Kuala Lumpur with Hasselbaink up front
news.title_zh: 著名的 CFC 将在哈塞尔巴因克的带领下来到吉隆坡
news.body_en: The Famous CFC, our international fan engagement programme, kicks off its 2026/27 events with a return to Malaysia in October, presented by Ascott. Legendary striker Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink will be part of the special weekend, meeting supporters in Malaysia, with the centrepiece being a watch party for our Premier League match against Manchester United on Saturday 31 October. Tickets to join Hasselbaink at the watch party will be allocated via a ballot which can be entered by completing the form below. Terms and conditions apply. By entering into this prize draw, you are signing up to join the Ascott Star Rewards (ASR) membership programme and enjoy ASR member benefits every time you travel. The information you provide as part of your entry will be shared between Chelsea FC and The Ascott Limited in accordance with Chelsea FC's privacy policy and Ascott's privacy policy. You will receive an ASR enrolment email after the prize draw concludes in October. Kuala Lumpur will see the live match screening as part of The Famous CFC, in partnership with The Ascott Limited, Chelsea FC’s official hotels partner. Ascott are also to give Chelsea fans who are Ascott Star Rewards members the chance to enjoy specially curated fan experience packages. The Famous CFC brings the Chelsea family together as part of our global community and last season the international programme spanned America, Australia, Asia and Africa. We previously enjoyed a Famous CFC weekend in Kuala Lumpur in February 2025 and anticipation is high for an equally exciting time for all, following the brilliant support for Xabi Alonso’s team in Malaysia for the club’s pre-season tour, when we took on Johor Darul Ta'zim in a match held in Iskandar Puteri. Hasselbaink was the legend greeting fans when the Famous CFC visited Vietnam and China previously, and Malaysia holds great memories for our former no.9. He was part of the Chelsea side that won the FA Premier League Asia Cup in Kuala Lumpur in the summer of 2003. The scorer of 87 goals in 177 Chelsea appearances, Jimmy remains one of the most prolific and popular centre-forwards to have worn our shirt. He was also a Premier League Golden Boot winner while a Blue. Hasselbaink said: 'I really enjoyed visiting Kuala Lumpur previously, having been there when Chelsea visited for the FA Premier League Asia Cup just over two decades ago. Reliving those memories will be special, but what excites me most is meeting our fans in Kuala Lumpur, a city where the passion of the Blues always comes alive. I experienced Ascott’s hospitality in Hanoi earlier this year, and I have no doubt they will deliver something special once again, for me and every one of our fans.'

news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 提供了凯拉·沃尔什 (Keira Walsh) 的最新伤情，并反思了“重要”的三分
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor revealed why midfielder Keira Walsh was substituted after 20 minutes during our 1-0 win over Austria Vienna on Wednesday night, before giving her thoughts on our overall performance. Walsh had to be replaced by Lexi Potter midway through the first half, but as the head coach explained, the substitution was more of a precaution than for anything serious. 'We were trying to be cautious with her,' said Bompastor. 'She just felt a little bit of something in her quad, so hopefully it's not too bad. We'll assess her tomorrow (Thursday) and see if she's available for Sunday's game. 'It's too soon now for me to tell you something. I will probably know more tomorrow and so you will have to wait for the press conference.' Maika Hamano replaced Melvine Malard at half-time during our 1-0 win, but Blues supporters need not worry about her early departure from the pitch. 'It was pre-planned,' continued the head coach. 'Today the plan was for Melvine to get 45 minutes. She didn't have a proper pre-season, so we are trying now to build her up for the next games. I think it was appropriate for her to get 45 minutes today and hopefully, she'll be fine to be available for the game on Sunday.' Despite playing in the Women's Champions League for the first time, Austria Vienna provided a stern test for Chelsea, and in fact, managed to match us in terms of shots on target as the game ended with six apiece. That was despite our superior possession of the ball, but Bompastor was not shocked by the threat they posed. 'I'm not surprised because I observed their games, especially the two games they played against Brann,' she continued. 'I think their physicality was really showcased in those two games. Tonight I put a really experienced team out to start the game, and the reason was we were expecting a tough test. 'Probably the performance is not the one we wanted to have. We could have controlled the game a little bit better in terms of maybe scoring the second goal, or killing the opposition's hope. But, you know, sometimes you need to also take what is most important, and I think tonight that was to win and to take the three points from the game. 'I think the players on these teams are able to match the intensity of a Champions League game from the beginning of the game until the end, as you could see tonight. The coaches are good in terms of the tactical aspects. When they come into the games, they are really well prepared, and they have a good game plan. 'So, as I said, nothing is easy. Tonight the most important thing was to win. To keep the clean sheet also. I think even if we conceded more situations than in our previous games, we stayed strong. We didn't concede, and that's good. I think we had a really good team performance in those aspects, in terms of mentality not to concede.' The Blues have no time to rest on the laurels of tonight's win, as we face a big London derby against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge on Sunday afternoon. Yet Bompastor was unconcerned about the turnaround time between the two fixtures and feels fully confident the team will be ready. 'We have enough time to recover for the game at the weekend,' she said. I'm not worried about that. I know we will be coming in with fresh legs and the game will be so different. And it's the London derby, so we'll be ready.' Don't miss our huge London derby clash against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge! Secure your seat now...
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托透露了周三晚上我们 1-0 战胜奥地利维也纳的比赛中，中场球员凯拉·沃尔什在 20 分钟后被换下的原因，然后对我们的整体表现发表了自己的看法。上半场中段，沃尔什不得不被莱克西·波特换下，但正如主教练所解释的那样，换人更多的是一种预防措施，而不是任何严重的事情。 “我们试图对她保持谨慎，”邦帕斯特说。 “她只是感觉到她的四肢上有一点异样，所以希望情况不会太糟糕。”我们将在明天（周四）对她进行评估，看看她是否可以参加周日的比赛。 “现在我告诉你一些事情还为时过早。明天我可能会知道更多，所以你必须等待新闻发布会。”在我们1-0获胜的比赛中，滨野麦卡在中场休息时替换了梅尔文·马拉德，但蓝军的支持者不必担心她提前离开球场。 “这是预先计划好的，”主教练继续说道。 “今天梅尔文的计划是上场 45 分钟。她没有参加适当的季前赛，所以我们现在正在努力让她为接下来的比赛做好准备。我认为她今天上场 45 分钟是合适的，希望她能顺利参加周日的比赛。”尽管是首次参加女足欧冠联赛，奥地利维也纳队还是给切尔西队带来了严峻的考验，事实上，他们在射正次数方面与我们不相上下，比赛结束时双方各打进六球。尽管我们拥有出色的控球权，但邦帕斯特并没有对他们构成的威胁感到震惊。 “我并不感到惊讶，因为我观察了他们的比赛，尤其是他们对阵布莱恩的两场比赛，”她继续说道。 “我认为他们的身体素质在这两场比赛中得到了真正的展示。今晚我派了一支非常有经验的队伍来开始比赛，原因是我们期待着一场艰难的考验。 “可能表演不是我们想要的。我们本可以更好地控制比赛，也许可以打进第二个进球，或者扼杀对手的希望。但是，你知道，有时你还需要抓住最重要的东西，我认为今晚那就是赢得比赛并从比赛中拿下三分。 “我认为这些球队的球员能够从比赛开始到结束都达到欧冠比赛的强度，正如你今晚所看到的那样。教练们在战术方面都做得很好。当他们进入比赛时，他们确实做好了充分的准备，并且有很好的比赛计划。 “所以，正如我所说，没有什么是容易的。今晚最重要的事情就是赢球。也保持零失球。我认为即使我们比之前的比赛失球更多，我们仍然保持强势。我们没有认输，这很好。我认为我们在这些方面表现得非常好，在不失球的心态方面。”蓝军没有时间满足于今晚胜利的荣誉，周日下午我们将在斯坦福桥迎战阿森纳的伦敦德比大战。然而，邦帕斯托并不关心两场比赛之间的周转时间，并且完全有信心球队会做好准备。 “我们有足够的时间为周末的比赛恢复，”她说。我对此并不担心。我知道我们会带着新鲜的球员进来，比赛将会非常不同。这是伦敦德比，所以我们会做好准备。”不要错过我们在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的伦敦德比大战！赶紧抢座位吧……

news.title: Match Report: Chelsea 1-0 Austria Vienna
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：切尔西 1-0 奥地利维也纳
news.body_en: Chelsea edged out a narrow win against a spirited Austria Vienna side at Plough Lane to earn three points in the opening league phase match of our Women's Champions League campaign. We returned to Wimbledon under the lights and immediately looked sharp in attack. When Wieke Kaptein spotted an opportunity to shoot on the edge of the penalty area, she seized it with a sublime effort that bounced down off the underside of the bar and got us off the mark with only 11 minutes played. There was concern for this evening's captain Keira Walsh, who had to be replaced after just 20 minutes, with Lexi Potter coming on in her place. And with our narrow advantage, Vienna took confidence and got a foothold in the contest, going close to finding an equaliser twice just before half-time. We had chances to extend our lead after the break, but in truth,  so did the determined visitors, who hit the post in the second half. Some excellent defending and superb saves from Livia Peng protected the clean sheet in a contest that was far from comfortable, but as is the Chelsea way, we found a way to take the three points. Sonia Bompastor made three alterations to the side that started in our 2-0 win over Birmingham at the weekend, switching goalkeeper Hannah Hampton for Livia Peng and bringing in Katie McCabe and Melvine Malard for Lucy Bronze and Potter. And for the second time in two matches, the Blues struck early to take the advantage. This time, Kaptein unleashed a confident strike from the edge of the penalty area, hitting the underside of the crossbar with such power that the ball continued on its trajectory, bouncing down and into the bottom corner. There was then some concern for Walsh, who went off with an apparent injury after just 20 minutes and was replaced by midfield counterpart Potter. Alyssa Thompson was lively down the right, and shot just wide of the opposite post after burning past her marker. Next, her agility served her well as she kept a chance alive by jumping over the onrushing goalkeeper before teeing up Melvine Malard, who headed just wide from close range. Vienna then had a chance to equalise as they fashioned an opening from an inswinging corner. Peng came out and made herself big, but the ball fell to Virginia Kirchberger, who blazed the follow-up over the bar. Buoyed by their attempt on goal, the visitors went close again soon afterwards as Louise Schoffel dragged her shot just wide of the post. After some more pressure from the away side, we created the first big chance of the second half just before the hour mark. Another fierce shot from Kaptein was parried by Vienna goalkeeper Jasmin Pal, and Sandy Baltimore saw her attempt blocked inside the area on the follow-up. This was turning into an enthralling encounter. As the Austrians broke down the other end, Peng did brilliantly to push a shot around the post and out for a corner. There was an air of frustration that we weren't further ahead as the match moved into the final stages. Ellie Carpenter laid a ball on a plate across the six-yard box on 65 minutes, but no Chelsea player was there to convert and Pal was able to palm the ball away. Carpenter went on the attack again with a trademark run down the right and was once again able to get her cross into the box. This time Sjoeke Nusken was there to get on the end of it, but the Germany international fired her volley over the bar. With 15 minutes to play, we survived a big scare. Modesta Uka, who had been causing us problems all evening, powered her way into position and saw her shot bounce off the right-hand post and out for a goal kick. This wasn't a match for the football purists, nor was it plain sailing for the Chelsea supporters in the stands, but we showed our resilience to take the points with a huge clash against Arsenal to come at Stamford Bridge on Sunday. We take our first three points towards Champions League qualification, with five more fixtures to come. A hotly-anticipated London derby against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge awaits us on Sunday, and it's not too late to secure your ticket by clicking here. news.body_zh: 切尔西在普劳巷以微弱优势险胜充满活力的奥地利维也纳队，在女足欧冠联赛首轮比赛中获得三分。我们在灯光下回到温布尔登，立刻就显得进攻犀利。当维克·卡普坦 (Wieke Kaptein) 发现禁区边缘射门的机会时，她以一脚精彩的射门抓住了机会，球从横梁下弹回，在比赛仅进行了 11 分钟后，我们就取得了进球。人们对今晚的队长凯拉·沃尔什 (Keira Walsh) 感到担忧，她在仅仅 20 分钟后就不得不被替换，莱克西·波特 (Lexi Potter) 接替了她的位置。凭借着微弱的优势，维也纳信心十足，在比赛中站稳了脚跟，半场结束前两次险些扳平比分。中场休息后我们有机会扩大领先优势，但事实上，意志坚定的客队也有机会扩大领先优势，他们在下半场击中了门柱。彭丽媛出色的防守和出色的扑救确保了这场比赛的不失球，但正如切尔西的方式一样，我们找到了拿下三分的方法。周末我们2-0战胜伯明翰的比赛中，索尼娅·邦帕斯特对首发阵容进行了三处调整，将守门员汉娜·汉普顿换成了彭丽媛，并用凯蒂·麦凯布和梅尔文·马拉德换下了露西·布朗兹和波特。两场比赛中，蓝军第二次早早就取得了优势。这一次，卡普坦在禁区边缘自信地射门，力量十足地击中横梁下侧，皮球继续沿其轨迹飞行，向下弹入底角。随后沃尔什受到了一些关注，他在仅仅20分钟后就明显受伤下场，并被中场对手波特换下。阿莉莎·汤普森在右路表现活跃，在突破盯防球员后射门稍稍偏出对方门柱。接下来，她的敏捷性为她提供了很好的帮助，她跳过了猛冲过来的守门员，然后将球传给梅尔文·马拉德，后者近距离头球稍稍偏出。随后维也纳有机会扳平比分，他们从内旋角球中创造了空当。彭出来后表现出色，但皮球落到了弗吉尼亚·基希伯格手中，后者的一脚射门高出横梁。在他们射门的鼓舞下，客队很快就再次接近，路易丝·舍费尔的射门稍稍偏出门柱。在客队施加更多压力后，我们在比赛结束前创造了下半场的第一个绝佳机会。卡普坦的另一次猛烈射门被维也纳门将贾斯明·帕尔挡出，桑迪·巴尔的摩随后在禁区内射门被挡出。这变成了一次令人着迷的邂逅。当奥地利队在另一端突破时，彭的一脚出色的射门绕过门柱，开出角球。当比赛进入最后阶段时，我们没有进一步领先，气氛令人沮丧。第 65 分钟，埃莉·卡彭特 (Ellie Carpenter) 在 6 码禁区外将球打在板上，但没有切尔西球员在场进行转换，帕尔将球挡开。卡彭特再次发起进攻，在右路进行了标志性的跑动，并再次将她的传中送入禁区。这一次，斯约克·努斯肯 (Sjoeke Nusken) 试图终结比赛，但这位德国国脚的凌空抽射高出横梁。比赛还剩 15 分钟时，我们度过了一场大惊吓。整个晚上都给我们带来麻烦的莫德斯塔·乌卡（Modesta Uka）迅速就位，看到她的射门从右侧门柱上弹起，射出球门球。这不是一场适合足球纯粹主义者的比赛，对于看台上的切尔西球迷来说也不是一帆风顺的，但我们在周日斯坦福桥与阿森纳的一场激烈交锋中展现了我们的韧性，拿下了积分。我们在欧冠资格赛中取得了前三分，接下来还有五场比赛。周日，备受期待的伦敦德比将在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳，现在点击此处购买门票还为时不晚。 切尔西：彭，卡彭特，布坎南，布尔曼，麦凯布，努斯肯，沃尔什（c）（波特，20），卡普坦，汤普森，巴尔的摩，马拉德（滨野h-t）未上场替补：汉普顿，鲁兹·布朗，青铜，拉斯，德拉格尼，比约恩，吉尔马，萨尔维进球者：卡普坦 11 黄牌：麦凯布 51 奥地利维也纳： Pal, Wenninger (c), Schiechtl, Kirchberger, Schoffel (Cordes 79), Potzl, Pfattner (Orkic 92), Weiss (Pucci 92), Hanshaw, Uka (Sisic 79), Pfanner (Jakobsen 66)未上场替补：Goetz, Gartner, Schorn, Pichler裁判：Miriama Bockova 不要错过我们的伦敦德比大战将在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳！赶紧抢座位吧……

news.title: Premier League ticket news: Manchester United at home - ticket application window closing

news.body_en: The ticket selling information has been announced for our final fixture of next month. Chelsea host Manchester United in a Premier League encounter on Saturday 31 October with a 12:30pm kick-off at Stamford Bridge. Home tickets for members for men’s team matches are now allocated through a new application process. For each home match, eligible members have a designated application window during which they can apply for tickets. Applications can be made individually or as a group, provided all members of the group are eligible to apply during that window. Tickets will be allocated one per person with a maximum of four per application. Please note: Loyalty points accrued so far this season will be applied to this fixture. To be successful in this ticket application window, fans will be required to have 9 loyalty points or more. Only supporters who are eligible willshow to be selectable in the application process. A list of all the loyalty points that could be accrued so far this season is available at the bottom of this page. Ticket application window opens – Monday 21 September 12pm Ticket application window closes – Thursday 24 September 12pm The ticket application window will be open for True Blue+, True Blue, CFC Blue and Junior Blue members. As part of the verification process, a pre-authorisation charge £0.01 will be applied to validate your payment card. No money will be taken at this stage, and the hold will be removed by your provider. Tickets for this match are priced at Category AA. Please click here for match ticket prices Tickets will appear on the Chelsea Official App prior to the event. Eligible members can submit their application through the official ticketing portal at any time during the window, supporters must ensure they are logged in to successfully apply. Applying earlier does not increase the likelihood of success, giving supporters greater flexibility to apply at a time that suits them. As part of the new ticket sales process, members who are eligible for concession-rate tickets are automatically assigned their price class. To ensure you are receiving the correct ticket, please take the time to check the date of birth on your account is accurate. You will only be allocated tickets in your selected areas unless you choose to be considered for other available options. If you only wish to be entered for tickets in one area of the stadium, please leave the second option blank. Please read the ticket application information carefully before submitting your application. Successful and unsuccessful applications will be notified by email within four working days of the ticket application window closing date. Successful applications will be charged to their payment card approximately at this time. Supporters are not able to use account credit for ticket application window purchases. All persons under the age of 16 will be required to attend with and sit next to, a person aged 18 years of age or over. Members and season ticket holders can purchase Westview tickets for Premier League home games via the Chelsea FC Official Ticketing Portal. news.title: Morgan Rogers Unlocked – coming tomorrow

news.body_en: Morgan Rogers joins us in the latest episode of CFC Unlocked and explains exclusively to CFC+ subscribers how he was shaped during his early career to become the game-changing player you now see at Chelsea, and you can watch it very soon. The full episode of Rogers’ CFC Unlocked appearance is coming tomorrow exclusively for CFC+ subscribers, but in the meantime you can get a sneak peak of what is to come in the trailer below. Sitting down for an in-depth chat at Cobham, our summer signing shares his unorthodox journey from playing alongside friend Cole Palmer in the Manchester City youth system to joining him at Chelsea, via a tour of the Football League. Rogers also explains how those experiences have shaped him as a person and a player, resulting in the creative playmaker who can now be seen making a big impact on the pitch for the Blues and the England national team. Morgan goes on to speak about much more than football, though. He also turns agony aunt by trying to solve supporters’ personal dilemmas, including his tips on dating at Stamford Bridge and how to handle that friend who insists they would have made it as a professional footballer if they hadn’t suffered an injury. All of that and more can be seen in the next episode of CFC Unlocked with Morgan Rogers, exclusively for CFC+ subscribers, tomorrow. If you aren't already subscribed, here is all the information you need on CFC+ and how to sign up to get access to exclusive content and live football. Meanwhile, while you wait for Thursday's latest release, you can check out the free preview of the next episode above, or enjoy any of the previous instalments of CFC Unlocked in the archive here.

news.title: Chelsea's Ultimate Goal of the Season: Group A vote
news.title_zh: 切尔西本赛季的终极进球：A组投票
news.body_en: Since the award began back in 2007, 20 brilliant strikes have been crowned Chelsea Goal of the Season, and now it is time for you to decide which is the ultimate winner. We have taken the 20 previous Goal of the Season winners and split them into four groups of five, with some unforgettable moments from Chelsea history going head-to-head. The top two goals from each group will progress to the quarter-finals, before further votes narrow the field down through the semi-finals and eventually to our Ultimate Goal of the Season. We begin with Group A and five superb goals spanning two decades, from Michael Essien’s thunderbolt against Arsenal to Pedro Neto’s dramatic late winner at Fulham. There is plenty of variety, too, with long-range strikes, an audacious outside-of-the-boot finish and one of Eden Hazard’s most memorable goals in Blue all among the contenders. Each of these goals has already earned your recognition by winning our Goal of the Season award. Now they are going up against each other. Watch all five contenders below, remind yourself of what made them so special, and head over to the Chelsea Official App to cast your vote for the goal you want to see progress. Cast your vote for our Ultimate Goal of the Season on the Chelsea Official App here A goal which needs little introduction. With the Blues trailing Arsenal at Stamford Bridge, Frank Lampard laid the ball back to Essien around 30 yards from goal and the midfielder unleashed an incredible swerving strike which flew into the top corner. Oscar made the difficult look effortless against QPR. Found by Cesc Fabregas on the right side of the penalty area, the Brazilian produced a wonderful first-time trivela, bending the ball perfectly inside the far post. A special goal, during the iconic 'Battle of the Bridge' match. With Tottenham leading 2-1 late on, Hazard exchanged passes with Diego Costa before curling a superb first-time finish into the top corner. The equaliser ended Spurs’ hopes of winning the Premier League title. Tomori certainly made his first Chelsea goal one to remember. The defender met a loose ball from outside the box with a brilliant first-time strike which curled beyond Rui Patricio and into the top-left corner of the goal. A dramatic winner and a spectacular finish. Deep into stoppage time at Craven Cottage, Neto received Enzo Fernandez’s pass inside the area, spun away from goal and smashed a left-footed strike into the roof of the net to complete our late come-back. Cast your vote for our Ultimate Goal of the Season on the Chelsea Official App here
news.body_zh: 自 2007 年开始评选以来，已有 20 个精彩进球被授予切尔西赛季最佳进球，现在是时候由您来决定哪一个是最终的获胜者了。我们将前 20 名赛季最佳进球得主分成四组，每组五人，与切尔西历史上一些令人难忘的时刻进行正面交锋。每个小组的前两名进球将进入四分之一决赛，然后进一步投票缩小进入半决赛的范围，并最终成为我们本赛季的终极进球。我们从A组开始，讲述了跨越二十年的五个精彩进球，从迈克尔·埃辛对阵阿森纳的雷霆万钧，到佩德罗·内托对阵富勒姆的戏剧性的最后制胜球。比赛也有很多变化，包括远距离射门、大胆的靴外射门以及阿扎尔在蓝军所有竞争者中最令人难忘的进球之一。这些进球中的每一个都已经赢得了我们的赛季最佳进球奖，从而赢得了您的认可。现在他们正在互相对抗。观看下面的所有五名竞争者，提醒自己是什么让他们如此特别，然后前往切尔西官方应用程序，为您希望看到进展的目标投票。在切尔西官方应用程序上为我们本赛季的终极进球投出一票 无需过多介绍的进球。当蓝军在斯坦福桥落后阿森纳时，弗兰克·兰帕德将球回传给距离球门约 30 码的埃辛，这位中场球员发动了一记令人难以置信的转身射门，球飞入球门上角。奥斯卡在对阵 QPR 的比赛中显得毫不费力。巴西人在禁区右侧被法布雷加斯发现，他第一次打出了精彩的特里维拉，将球完美地弯曲到远门柱内。在标志性的“大桥之战”比赛中，一个特殊的进球。热刺最后时刻2-1领先时，阿扎尔与迭戈·科斯塔交换传球，然后将一记精彩的弧线球射入球门上角。扳平比分的进球终结了热刺夺得英超冠军的希望。托莫里的第一个切尔西进球无疑令人难忘。这名后卫在禁区外接到了一个松散的球，第一次精彩的射门越过了鲁伊·帕特里西奥，飞入了球门的左上角。戏剧性的胜利和壮观的结局。在克拉文小屋补时阶段，内托在禁区内接到恩佐·费尔南德斯的传球，转身离开球门，左脚射门破门，完成了我们最后的逆转。在切尔西官方应用程序上为我们本赛季的终极进球投票

news.title: New members of the Fan Advisory Board revealed
news.title_zh: 粉丝顾问委员会新成员揭晓
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club is pleased to announce the newest members of the Fan Advisory Board (FAB). Following a formal selection process, three new members of the FAB have been selected. We are pleased to welcome Darren Williams, Peter Trenter and Jon Kelly to the FAB for the first time. We also welcome back Arjun Pillai who was successfully reselected to his existing position. All four have been appointed for two seasons. We received a high volume of applications, and each candidate was interviewed by a panel formed of independent representatives from the supporter base, the club board and the Football Supporters’ Association. Our newest members will be joining our elected representatives, Neil Beard, Tracey Chapman and Anna Phillips, who all hold the position of supporter advisors to the board. For the 2026/27 season, the FAB will continue to meet with the club on a regular basis, providing advice and guidance on strategic initiatives and the impact on fan sentiment. Michael Cornall, head of supporter relations, said: ‘We look forward to welcoming Jon, Darren and Peter to the Fan Advisory Board. ‘It is vital that the FAB is representative of our supporter base. We are delighted to welcome our newest members and look forward to their range of perspectives contributing to and enriching the discussions we have as a group.’ Short biographies of our newest members can be read below: Peter’s first game at Chelsea was in 1968. He is a senior concession home and away season ticket holder as well as chair of the Chelsea Supporters Group. He is looking forward to joining the FAB and representing Chelsea supporters when important decisions are proposed that will affect our passionate fan base. Darren is a military veteran and lifelong Chelsea fan. After many years of being a Chelsea member, Darren finally achieved his goal and is an ambulant season ticket holder for the 2026/27 season. He proudly follows Chelsea regularly and is excited by his role on the FAB while continuing to support the club home and away. Jon is an avid Chelsea supporter and a Club Chelsea season ticket holder who regularly attends home and away matches with his three sons. A retired finance professional with over 20 years' industry experience, Jon is committed to ensuring fans' voices genuinely provide input on decisions across the club. Arjun has been reappointed for a further two years on the FAB. He attended his first match at the age of six and has been a season ticket holder for nearly 20 years as well as a Chelsea Pitch Owners shareholder. Arjun has worked in investment banking in both New York and London. He is also chair of the Growth Board at Bloomsbury Football Foundation and is a graduate from the University of Oxford. The newest members of the FAB are in place of Zane Elmasri, Emily Kraftman and Mark Meehan. We thank all three for their dedication and commitment to the club. More information on the FAB, including a recent newsletter, can be found here
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部很高兴宣布球迷顾问委员会 (FAB) 的最新成员。经过正式选拔流程后，FAB 的三名新成员已被选出。我们很高兴地欢迎达伦·威廉姆斯、彼得·特伦特和乔恩·凯利首次来到 FAB。我们还欢迎阿尔琼·皮莱 (Arjun Pillai) 再次当选，他已成功重新担任现有职位。所有四人都被任命为两个赛季。我们收到了大量的申请，每位候选人都接受了由来自球迷群体、俱乐部董事会和足球支持者协会的独立代表组成的小组的面试。我们的最新成员将加入我们选出的代表尼尔·比尔德、特雷西·查普曼和安娜·菲利普斯的行列，他们都担任董事会的支持顾问。 2026/27赛季，FAB将继续定期与俱乐部会面，就战略举措以及对球迷情绪的影响提供建议和指导。支持者关系主管迈克尔·康纳尔 (Michael Cornall) 表示：“我们期待着乔恩、达伦和彼得加入粉丝顾问委员会。 “FAB 代表我们的支持者群体至关重要。我们很高兴欢迎我们的新成员，并期待他们的各种观点能够为我们作为一个团队的讨论做出贡献并丰富我们的讨论。”我们最新成员的简短传记如下： 彼得在切尔西的第一场比赛是在 1968 年。他是高级特许主客场季票持有者，也是切尔西支持者小组的主席。他期待着加入 FAB，并在提出影响我们热情球迷群的重要决定时代表切尔西支持者。达伦是一名退伍军人，也是切尔西的终身球迷。成为切尔西会员多年后，达伦终于实现了自己的目标，成为 2026/27 赛季流动季票持有者。他自豪地定期关注切尔西，并对自己在 FAB 中的角色感到兴奋，同时继续主客场支持俱乐部。乔恩是一位狂热的切尔西球迷，也是切尔西俱乐部季票持有者，他经常与他的三个儿子一起观看主客场比赛。 Jon 是一位拥有 20 多年行业经验的退休金融专业人士，致力于确保球迷的声音真正为整个俱乐部的决策提供意见。 Arjun 再次被任命为 FAB 成员，任期两年。他六岁时第一次观看比赛，近 20 年来一直持有季票，同时也是切尔西球场所有者的股东。 Arjun 曾在纽约和伦敦的投资银行工作。他还是布卢姆斯伯里足球基金会增长委员会主席，毕业于牛津大学。 FAB 的最新成员取代了 Zane Elmasri、Emily Kraftman 和 Mark Meehan。我们感谢三人对俱乐部的奉献和承诺。有关 FAB 的更多信息，包括最近的新闻通讯，请访问此处

news.title: Nathalie Bjorn on a fresh start, vice captaincy and Austria Vienna test
news.title_zh: 娜塔莉·比约恩 (Nathalie Bjorn) 重新开始、副队长和奥地利维也纳考验
news.body_en: Newly named Chelsea vice-captain Nathalie Bjorn has explained how her emotional return to the pitch feels like a fresh start following her difficult year with injuries last season. The defender was first ruled out in December 2025 and made her return as a substitute during our Women's League Cup final win over Manchester United in March 2026. Minutes after entering the pitch, Bjorn suffered a cruel twist of fate that would keep her out until she successfully made her return in last Saturday's victory against Birmingham City. It was clear that the Sweden international was full of emotion after the final whistle at Stamford Bridge at the weekend, having been given a rousing reception by the Chelsea faithful. Her courage through a difficult journey was also acknowledged by her team-mates and the Blues staff after the match. 'I had such a warm welcome from both my team-mates and the fans at the stadium,' she tells us. 'It was really nice, and I’m super happy to make my return and to get that warm welcome. It means the world to me. 'Last season wasn't the best for our team and for me personally, so this season feels like a fresh start. I’m going to take it step by step, but so far it feels good.' The experienced Bjorn was named as one of new skipper Erin Cuthbert's vice-captains at the start of the campaign, alongside Lucy Bronze. Describing the new responsibility as an 'honour', the defender explained what she will bring to the table as a senior leader and recounted how she was first informed of the vice-captaincy award. 'Sonia took us into a meeting and told us that we were the chosen vice-captains, which was really nice, of course,' Bjorn says. 'I'm really happy for that and to get that confidence from the girls. Of course, it's an honour. Especially because the players that I play with every day are top, top athletes playing for their countries, and I'm really honoured to be voted for by them. 'In terms of my leadership style, I would say I’m a calm leader. I’m open, very easy to talk to, and I just try to see everyone in the changing room.' After qualifying for this season's Women's Champions League with a 6-2 aggregate win over Real Sociedad, we begin the league phase of the competition with a fixture against Austria Vienna at Plough Lane tonight. Now fit and ready to play, Bjorn explains where she feels the team is up to, and what kind of challenges playing in Europe will bring. 'We're in a good phase at the moment,' she explains. 'The new players have settled in really well, I would say. We have unique players coming in with their qualities, and they can help this group. And I feel like we're a tight group, too. 'We had some good performances in the last few games; we're playing well at the moment, and we just need to keep building on that. 'The Champions League format is different, and it feels like every game is so much more important, so we need to be on our A game. It doesn't matter who we play against, we know it's tight in the Champions League, but here is exactly where we want to be. 'They know it's a 90-minute game, and everything can happen, so they will put their heart into that performance and do everything to try to beat us. We need to stay patient, and we need to keep playing like we've been playing for the last few games and score some goals.' Bjorn scored in our incredible 3-0 Champions League quarter-final comeback win against Manchester City at Stamford Bridge in 2024/25. She understands that nights like that are the prize for coming through these early encounters, and she wants more of the same this season. 'That night was an unforgettable one for all of us,' she smiles. 'I mean, playing those games again, playing against top teams, competing for a trophy. It's the most precious trophy, and it's a trophy that we want to lay our hands on.'
news.body_zh: 新任命的切尔西副队长纳塔莉·比约恩解释了上赛季因伤病度过的艰难一年后，她重返球场的感觉就像是一个新的开始。这名后卫于 2025 年 12 月首次被排除在外，并在 2026 年 3 月我们战胜曼联的女足联赛杯决赛中作为替补回归。上场几分钟后，比约恩遭遇了残酷的命运转折，这让她无法上场，直到上周六战胜伯明翰城的比赛中她成功回归。很明显，这位瑞典国脚在周末斯坦福桥终场哨声响起后，受到了切尔西球迷的热烈欢迎，他情绪激动。赛后，她在艰难旅程中的勇气也得到了队友和蓝军工作人员的认可。 “我在体育场受到了队友和球迷的热烈欢迎，”她告诉我们。 “这真的很好，我非常高兴能回来并受到热烈的欢迎。这对我来说意味着整个世界。 “上赛季对我们球队和我个人来说都不是最好的，所以这个赛季感觉像是一个新的开始。我会一步一步来，但到目前为止感觉还不错。”经验丰富的比约恩在赛季开始时被任命为新队长艾琳·卡斯伯特的副队长之一，与露西·青铜并肩作战。这位后卫将新的职责描述为一种“荣誉”，解释了她作为高级领导者将带来什么，并讲述了她是如何第一次得知副队长奖的。 “索尼娅带我们参加了一次会议，并告诉我们我们被选为副队长，这当然很好，”比约恩说。 “我对此感到非常高兴，并从女孩们那里得到了信心。当然，这是一种荣幸。特别是因为每天和我一起比赛的球员都是顶尖的，为他们的国家效力的顶尖运动员，我真的很荣幸能被他们投票。 “就我的领导风格而言，我会说我是一个冷静的领导者。我很开放，很容易交谈，我只是试着看到更衣室里的每个人。”在以总比分 6-2 战胜皇家社会队获得本赛季女子冠军联赛资格后，我们今晚将在普劳巷对阵奥地利维也纳队，开始联赛阶段的比赛。现在，比约恩已经康复并准备好参加比赛，她解释了她认为球队的发展方向，以及在欧洲比赛会带来什么样的挑战。 “我们目前正处于一个良好的阶段，”她解释道。 “我想说，新球员已经很好地适应了。我们拥有独特的球员，他们的素质很高，他们可以帮助这个团队。我觉得我们也是一个紧密的团队。 “我们在过去几场比赛中表现出色；我们现在打得很好，我们只需要在此基础上继续努力。 “冠军联赛的赛制不同，感觉每场比赛都重要得多，所以我们需要打出最好的比赛。我们对阵谁并不重要，我们知道欧冠联赛的形势很紧张，但这正是我们想要达到的目标。 “他们知道这是一场90分钟的比赛，一切都有可能发生，所以他们会全心全意地投入到比赛中，并尽一切努力击败我们。我们需要保持耐心，我们需要像过去几场比赛一样继续比赛，并取得一些进球。” 2024/25赛季欧冠四分之一决赛，我们在斯坦福桥以3-0逆转曼城，比约恩攻入一球。她明白这样的夜晚是经历这些早期遭遇的奖赏，她希望本赛季能有更多这样的夜晚。 “那天晚上对我们所有人来说都是难忘的一晚，”她微笑着说。 “我的意思是，再次参加那些比赛，与顶级球队比赛，争夺奖杯。这是最珍贵的奖杯，也是我们想要拿到的奖杯。”

news.title: Keira Walsh on getting in the goals and Lexi Potter comparisons
news.title_zh: 凯拉·沃尔什 (Keira Walsh) 谈进球数和莱克西·波特 (Lexi Potter) 的比较
news.body_en: Keira Walsh has explained how a small change to her role is allowing her to carry more of a goal threat this season and responded to her young team-mate Lexi Potter being labelled as ‘the new Keira Walsh’ by some. Midfielder Walsh has been heavily involved in Chelsea Women’s attacking play this season and has found the net twice already in 2026/27, including scoring the only goal in our 1-0 win away at Real Sociedad in the UEFA Women’s Champions League qualifying play-off. We open our league phase campaign in that competition by hosting Austria Vienna at Plough Lane this evening, and speaking before that game Walsh was asked what was behind her form for the Blues in the final third. ‘I think there’s obviously been a change of formation. When you play with one pivot, obviously your job is to stop transitions. So it's not normally my role to try and get in the box and score,’ the England international explained. ‘When Lexi's playing alongside me, she makes me feel really comfortable and she gives me the freedom to go and do those things, and we've got a great partnership. I think that's probably where most of my confidence comes from. ‘I know that if I'm in the box and I'm trying to arrive and make a difference at that end, that she's going to sit and have my back at the other end. So I think for me it's probably mostly about that. ‘But I do practice a little bit more now, and I know Sonia [Bompastor] and Cammy [Camille Abily] are always telling me to shoot more, so I guess it's just taking those opportunities. And just being higher up and closer to the box allows me to do that as well.’ Her midfield partnership with Potter is an area of the team that has caught the eye during the early stages of this season, with the 20-year-old being likened by many to her more experienced team-mate. When those comparisons were put to her, Walsh herself was full of praise for Potter and excited about the young midfielder’s potential to star for Chelsea in the future. ‘She's probably going to be better than me, to be honest,’ Keira responded with a laugh. ‘She's quietly confident. In training she works really hard and she's probably deserved that this season. So I'm enjoying playing with her and hopefully she feels the same about me as well. ‘I don't mean to put too much pressure on her with that, to be fair, but the way we see the game is very similar. We both see football in a very tactical way and I've really enjoyed playing with her so far. ‘I think Sonia said in one of her interviews the biggest compliment she has is her consistency. She doesn't try and set the world alight with every performance. She's just very good every time she plays and I think that's the most important thing in that position. ‘When you watch other midfielders play in those positions, they're always very consistent, and that is something that Lexi has brought in these last games. Hopefully that continues. I think she's been a really key piece for us so far.’ Walsh and Potter will be looking to show that consistency and attacking threat once again when Chelsea take on Austria Vienna this evening, hoping to get our Women’s Champions League campaign off to a winning start in west London.
news.body_zh: 凯拉·沃尔什解释了她的角色的一个小变化如何让她在本赛季承担更多的进球威胁，并对她的年轻队友莱克西·波特被一些人称为“新凯拉·沃尔什”做出了回应。中场球员沃尔什本赛季积极参与切尔西女足的进攻，并在 2026/27 赛季已经两次进球，其中包括在欧洲女子冠军联赛资格附加赛中我们客场 1-0 战胜皇家社会队的比赛中攻入唯一进球。我们今晚将在普劳巷主场迎战奥地利维也纳，以此拉开我们联赛阶段的序幕。沃尔什在比赛前发言时被问及她在蓝军最后三分之一表现的背后是什么。 “我认为阵型显然发生了变化。当你使用一个枢轴时，显然你的工作就是停止转换。因此，尝试进入禁区并得分通常不是我的角色，”这位英格兰国脚解释道。 “当莱克西和我一起打球时，她让我感觉非常舒服，她给了我去做这些事情的自由，我们有很好的合作关系。我想这可能就是我大部分信心的来源。 “我知道，如果我在禁区里，并且我试图到达并在这一端有所作为，那么她就会坐在另一端支持我。所以我认为对我来说这可能主要是关于这个。 “但我现在确实多了一点练习，而且我知道索尼娅（邦帕斯特）和卡米（卡米尔阿比利）总是告诉我要多投篮，所以我想我只是抓住了这些机会。”站得更高、更靠近禁区也能让我做到这一点。”她与波特的中场搭档是球队在本赛季初期引起关注的一个领域，这位 20 岁的球员被许多人比作她更有经验的队友。当这些比较发生在她身上时，沃尔什本人对波特赞不绝口，并对这位年轻中场球员未来成为切尔西明星的潜力感到兴奋。 “说实话，她可能会比我更好，”凯拉笑着回答。 “她安静地自信。在训练中她非常努力，这个赛季她可能是应得的。所以我很享受和她一起玩，希望她也对我有同样的感觉。 “公平地说，我并不是想给她太大压力，但我们看待比赛的方式非常相似。我们都以非常战术的方式看待足球，到目前为止我真的很喜欢和她一起踢球。 “我认为索尼娅在一次采访中说过，她最大的赞美就是她的一致性。她并没有试图让每场表演都点燃世界。她每次比赛都表现得非常好，我认为这是这个位置上最重要的事情。 “当你观察其他中场球员在这些位置上的比赛时，你会发现他们总是非常稳定，这就是莱克西在最近几场比赛中带来的东西。希望这种情况能够持续下去。我认为到目前为止，她对我们来说是一个非常关键的球员。当切尔西今晚迎战奥地利维也纳时，沃尔什和波特将寻求再次展现出这种稳定性和进攻威胁，希望我们的女足冠军联赛在伦敦西部取得一个胜利的开局。

news.title: Chelsea FC Legends return to Stamford Bridge against Tottenham Hotspur Legends

news.body_en: A legendary rivalry will be reignited when Chelsea FC Legends take on Tottenham Hotspur Legends at Stamford Bridge on Saturday 27 March 2027. Falling during Easter Weekend, the match will be raising crucial funds for Chelsea Foundation and its work bringing people together, creating healthier lives and shaping brighter futures in our local communities. Chelsea FC Legends will be returning to Stamford Bridge which has seen some of the club’s most historic battles against their former rivals. Laura Cordingley, Chief Executive of Chelsea FC Foundation, said: ‘We are delighted to announce the next Legends match at Stamford Bridge, and I would like to thank the club for its support in making this happen. ‘This match against Tottenham Hotspur will reignite a legendary rivalry on the pitch, providing our supporters with the opportunity to see some of their heroes back at Stamford Bridge, whilst also raising vital funds for Chelsea Foundation’s life-changing impact off the pitch. We look forward to putting on an incredible event on Saturday 27 March.’ Ticket sales for this match will be as follows: Monday 5 October from 12pm until Wednesday 7 October at 9am: Season ticket holders can purchase tickets. Wednesday 7 October from 10am until Wednesday 7 October at 1pm: True Blue+, True Blue and Junior Blue members have priority access to purchase tickets. Wednesday 7 October from 2pm: Members with a True Blue+, True Blue or Junior Blue Membership who have not already purchased a match ticket and members with CFC Blue Membership can purchase tickets. Thursday 8 October from 10am: Tickets will be available on general sale. Tickets will be sold online only, subject to availability, and are priced as follows: Adults  £35 Juniors (under 20)  £17.50 Under 23  £17.50Seniors (66 or over)  £17.50 Personal Assistant - free of charge The match will also provide support for Spurs in the Community. Marc Leckie, Chief Executive of Spurs in the Community, said: ‘We’re delighted to be part of what promises to be a fantastic occasion at Stamford Bridge. Matches between Tottenham Hotspur and Chelsea have produced so many memorable moments over the years, and it will be great to see some familiar faces come together again. We’re very grateful for the support the fixture will provide to our work and look forward to what should be a special day.’ Let us know by filling in this form. news.body_zh: 2027 年 3 月 27 日星期六，切尔西足球俱乐部传奇队在斯坦福桥迎战托特纳姆热刺传奇队，一场传奇的较量将重新燃起。这场比赛在复活节周末举行，将为切尔西基金会及其将人们聚集在一起、创造更健康的生活和塑造我们当地社区更光明的未来的工作筹集重要资金。切尔西传奇队将重返斯坦福桥，这里见证了俱乐部与前对手的一些最具历史意义的战斗。切尔西足球俱乐部基金会首席执行官劳拉·科丁利 (Laura Cordingley) 表示：“我们很高兴宣布下一场传奇比赛将在斯坦福桥举行，我要感谢俱乐部为实现这一目标所提供的支持。 “这场对阵托特纳姆热刺的比赛将重新点燃球场上的传奇竞争，让我们的支持者有机会在斯坦福桥见到他们的英雄，同时也为切尔西基金会在球场外改变生活的影响筹集重要资金。我们期待在 3 月 27 日星期六举办一场令人难以置信的赛事。这场比赛的门票销售如下：10 月 5 日星期一中午 12 点至 10 月 7 日星期三上午 9 点：季票持有者可以购买门票。 10 月 7 日星期三上午 10 点至 10 月 7 日星期三下午 1 点：True Blue+、True Blue 和 Junior Blue 会员可优先购买门票。 10 月 7 日星期三下午 2 点起：尚未购买比赛门票的 True Blue+、True Blue 或 Junior Blue 会员会员以及 CFC Blue 会员会员可以购买门票。 10 月 8 日星期四上午 10 点起：门票将公开发售。门票仅在网上出售，售完即止，价格如下： 成人 35 英镑 青少年（20 岁以下） 17.50 英镑 23 岁以下 17.50 英镑 老年人（66 岁或以上） 17.50 英镑 个人助理 - 免费 本场比赛还将为热刺社区提供支持。热刺社区首席执行官马克·莱基表示：“我们很高兴能够参与斯坦福桥的精彩活动。托特纳姆热刺和切尔西之间的比赛多年来产生了许多难忘的时刻，很高兴看到一些熟悉的面孔再次聚在一起。我们非常感谢该装置将为我们的工作提供支持，并期待这将是一个特殊的日子。”请填写此表格让我们知道。成为第一批了解有关比赛和回归桥的传奇人物的更多信息的人。
